jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager - Tech, OpsTech Solutions, Delivery Software Engineering (DSE)
jobs.description:
Every Amazon package that ships, every grocery order that is fulfilled, and every locker that opens depends on technology our teams keep running. Amazon’s OpsTech Solutions (OTS) is the IT operations and infrastructure organization for all of Amazon Worldwide Operations including Worldwide Grocery Stores (WWGS), delivering reliable technology to more than one million associates and operators across every geography and all business miles. OTS is transforming from reactive support to proactive, AI-powered service delivery. The data products powering that transformation are at the center of how the organization plans, decides, and operates.
What this role is: You will own the product strategy for the OTS Data Products portfolio, spanning four data products (Nodal Efficiency, Timesheet Adherence, Scenario Planner, and Short Term Planning) and five agentic workflow products (Printer Agent, MCM Agent, CSDA, OTS MCP, and OneVoice). You decide what gets built, what gets deprecated, and how these products become one coherent, reusable portfolio. This is the role that determines whether OTS’s data investments compound or stay siloed.
This is a platform and portfolio role. You will work across two engineering organizations, ANCHOR and Delivery Software Engineering (DSE), as well as partner analytics and program teams. An emerging ecosystem of AI agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) services is an important part of the landscape, but your scope is the wider OTS data products estate, not any single team or service. You will define and drive the shared product strategy, standards, and access layer that these teams build on and that OTS customers consume.
Across OTS, teams have built valuable data products (forecasting services, operational metrics grounded in validated data), each proven in its own domain. The opportunity is to connect these strong point solutions across third-party platforms (ServiceNow) and in-house 1P services into one coherent portfolio, so that every new data-driven solution becomes a matter of configuration and connection rather than a net-new build. Your customers span field technicians who consume operational intelligence, program managers who configure forecasts and derive AI-driven insights, leaders who query validated metrics in natural language, and engineers who integrate with data products programmatically.
Key Highlights
• Own the product strategy and roadmap for the OTS Data Products portfolio (forecasting, science, analytics, and data tooling) across ANCHOR and Delivery Software Engineering (DSE) teams.
• Drive the reactive-to-proactive transformation by making OTS data accessible, reusable, and trustworthy through a foundational-services model: design once, deploy many.
• Shape the AI agent and MCP access layer that lets operators and leaders reach OTS data through natural-language and programmatic interfaces.
• Set the direction that multiple engineering teams build toward, backed by executive sponsorship and a clear mandate across the portfolio.
• Serve diverse customer personas across a spectrum of data latencies, from near-real-time operational needs on the front line to executive-level strategic insights.

Key job responsibilities
• Define and own a multi-year product vision and roadmap for OTS data products, unifying forecasting, science, analytics, and the AI agent and MCP ecosystem into one coherent portfolio.
• Act as the voice of the customer across OTS program teams, translating operational needs into product requirements and making disciplined trade-offs between time, effort, and feature depth.
• Partner with engineering leaders across contributing teams to shape architecture decisions, resolve overlap between services (e.g., ensuring a knowledge graph calls an existing metrics service rather than duplicating it), and drive build-vs-buy-vs-reuse decisions.
• Drive the AI agent and MCP access-layer strategy, establishing clear ownership boundaries between the common front door and supporting data services.
• Establish north-star and adoption metrics that make the foundational-services thesis measurable, and own the Monthly and Quarterly Business Review reporting standards that keep the portfolio accountable.
• Align partner engineering teams and stakeholders across competing priorities — driving adoption so teams choose to build on the shared portfolio rather than around it.
• Contribute to annual planning mechanisms (OP1/OP2) with clear, well-reasoned investment proposals, and maintain mechanisms to continuously capture voice of the customer from both internal OTS employees and operational customers.

A day in the life
Your day moves between strategy and execution. You review portfolio metrics, update roadmaps with the contributing teams, run voice-of-the-customer sessions to make sure priorities reflect real operational pain points across personas, from a field technician relying on operational intelligence to a leader asking a natural-language question of validated metrics. You join architecture discussions to resolve how forecasting, the MCP and agent layer, supporting data services fit together, and where boundaries between overlapping services should sit. In the afternoon, you make prioritization trade-offs with engineering leaders across teams whose roadmaps you influence but do not control, then shift to drafting strategy narratives and investment proposals for senior review.

About the team
OTS sits within Amazon’s largest support organization for Worldwide Operations, building a broader strategy to enhance support operations through technology and AI. OTS data products are how that strategy becomes actionable: forecasting and science services that help program teams plan, operational metrics grounded in validated data, and an emerging AI agent and MCP ecosystem that meets users at the point of need. The ANCHOR team is a key contributor to this landscape, delivering products such as OPAL and agentic tooling, and it partners with Delivery Software Engineering (DSE), Global Workforce Management (GWM), and the OTS and RME program teams. This role defines what the OTS data products portfolio should be across those teams; the engineering organizations deliver the how.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
- Experience working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage
- Demonstrated ability to influence and align partner engineering teams and stakeholders across competing priorities, without direct authority.
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience bridging technical and business teams to collect and refine requirements, prioritize incoming work requests, and ensure all committed work is delivered on time
- MBA
- Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
- Background in operations-heavy domains is a plus but not required. IT infrastructure, field operations, and operational technology are the domains this role serves — strong product judgment and the ability to learn a new domain quickly matter more than prior OTS or IT experience.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Technical, ASCS Legal
jobs.description:
Amazon Legal is seeking a hands-on, AI-native Product Manager – Technical to transform how legal work gets done for Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS). This is a technical product role requiring deep architecture influence, sitting at the intersection of ASCS’s engineering roadmaps and the legal risks our team manages. You will spend the majority of your time building working AI agents and automation, and shaping how ASCS products are built alongside engineering.

As the ideal candidate, you bring enough technical depth to have credibility with the engineering teams you work with. You can dive into technical detail with engineers and drive constructive discussion, ask the right questions about technology choices and architecture trade-offs, spot risks and failure modes, recognize when the technical information you have been given is inaccurate or not yet well understood, and know when a design is complex enough to warrant a principal engineer’s review. You pair that with hands-on building: you have configured AI agents, LLM-powered workflows, and no-code and low-code platforms yourself, with the judgment to know when a tool is good enough to ship and the discipline to measure whether it actually gets used. And you carry enough legal-adjacent fluency (which is to say, you have worked alongside lawyers and understand why a privacy or commercial position matters) to be trusted in both the engineering room and the legal one. You read a manual process, separate the genuine judgment from the scaffolding, and you redesign the work so AI carries the process and the legal team is freed to focus on the judgment.

This role involves access to confidential legal information and requires a high level of professionalism, integrity, and discretion.

Key job responsibilities
Build, deploy, and maintain AI agents and automation workflows that scale the legal team’s impact, which includes client-facing tooling that synthesizes existing legal guidance into interfaces that problem-solve quickly.

Own a clear customer experience and roadmap for legal tooling, and make the ongoing strategic decisions about direction and priorities that the product requires.

Engage credibly with ASCS engineering teams early in their roadmaps, evaluate technical proposals and architecture trade-offs, and shape design decisions alongside engineering to influence technical direction for compliance.

Identify technical intersections where compliance can be built into the product, foresee the consequences of design choices, and surface the associated legal risks back to the legal team.

Think big about how automation makes coordination unnecessary rather than merely faster, which enables the team to amplify and scale its impact.

jobs.description:

You will define how Amazon communicates with and protects customers when products are recalled or flagged for safety concerns, ensuring customers can discover, understand, and act on safety information across every Amazon surface and purchase channel. This role owns a portfolio of 20+ features across customer notification channels, verification workflows, and a centralized remediation platform, with direct impact on an SPS-level goal to improve worldwide customer remediation effectiveness. You will work with engineering, science, operations, legal, and UX teams to ship capabilities that protect customers at scale.

-Own the product roadmap for customer remediation, including recall notification delivery, customer engagement surfaces, verification of destruction workflows, and the centralized remediation hub
-Define and drive the product strategy for expanding customer remediation coverage to new channels (in-app, messaging platforms, voice), new purchase categories, and new geographies

You will spend your day balancing strategic planning with hands-on product delivery. In a given week, you might review ML model accuracy metrics for image verification, define requirements for a new notification channel, align with operations on recall case workflows, and present roadmap tradeoffs to leadership. Your customers are both the Amazon shoppers who need clear, timely information about product safety and the internal teams who execute remediation at scale. You will own decisions end to end, from defining what gets built to measuring whether it worked.

Amazon Compliance Safety Services protects customers and sellers by ensuring products sold on Amazon meet safety and compliance requirements worldwide. The Customer Remediation team within CoSS is responsible for how Amazon reaches customers affected by product recalls and safety alerts, how customers verify compliance actions, and how internal teams execute remediation workflows. jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager - Tech, AWS Observability
jobs.description:
Are you a tech-savvy storyteller who can translate complex cloud solutions into compelling customer value? At AWS, we're seeking a Product Marketing Manager who can shape the future of AWS Observability portfolio.

Observability has never mattered more. As organizations deploy AI applications, foundation models, and autonomous agents into production, they need to understand not just whether infrastructure is healthy, but whether their AI is reasoning correctly, whether model performance is drifting, and whether systems can self-heal before customers notice. The infrastructure behind this processes quadrillions of data points daily. This is the new frontier, and you'll be at the center of it.

In this role, you'll work backwards from customer needs to influence strategy across the portfolio. We're looking for someone who can dive deep into how modern monitoring solutions work while simultaneously crafting portfolio-level value propositions that resonate with SREs, developers building with generative AI, and platform engineering teams. You'll partner with product and GTM teams to shape positioning for modern use cases like AI application monitoring, agent observability, multicloud visibility, and proactive operations. You'll synthesize competitive intelligence, develop messaging that moves customers from reactive monitoring to autonomous operations, and drive launches that earn attention at scale.

Key job responsibilities
- Partner with product management and GTM teams to develop portfolio-level strategy documents and guide AWS Observability services including Amazon CloudWatch and AI-powered operations capabilities in AWS DevOps Agent.
- Create and own positioning and messaging that clearly articulates value propositions to customers, from infrastructure monitoring through AI application and agent observability
- Analyze and synthesize market data from multiple sources (including direct customer feedback and competitive intelligence) to identify product opportunities and shape portfolio strategy
- Lead product launch strategies and associated plans, including naming, target audience definition, and marketing vehicles for observability services launching into an increasingly AI-driven market
- Develop technical content including presentations, demonstrations, and customer stories that educate developers, SREs, and platform engineering teams on how AWS Observability addresses modern use cases
- Drive field enablement strategies to support product launches, campaigns, and customer success across observability and AI operations
- Align with technical and business leaders on primary observability use cases for their specific ideal customer profiles: from multicloud visibility and cost-aware telemetry to autonomous remediation and AI application reliability

About the team
Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Tech, Electrical Products and Services, Data Center Engineering
jobs.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain, and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Sr. Technical Product Manager creates and drives the next generation of medium voltage (MV) products, including Medium Voltage Switchgear (MVS) and Medium Voltage Transformers (MVT), from concept to at-scale global deployment. This role provides a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of power distribution infrastructure and hyper-scale data center growth. The Sr. PM-T applies their expertise to:

- Design, develop, launch, and support MV switchgear and transformer products critical to data center electrical infrastructure
- Lead New Product Introduction (NPI) efforts for MVS and MVT programs, coordinating design validation, prototype builds, testing, and production readiness milestones
- Drive supplier qualification activities, evaluating and onboarding MV equipment suppliers to meet AWS quality, reliability, and capacity requirements
- Identify and execute cost reduction initiatives across the MV product portfolio while maintaining or improving product performance and reliability
- Engage with internal and external Amazon customers and support teams to capture critical medium voltage power distribution needs for current operations, rack roadmaps, and new data center designs
- Utilize those insights to define product requirements, create a product vision, and own the product development roadmap for MVS and MVT programs
- Coordinate between multiple teams to develop business cases that substantiate value, define product prioritization, and outline budget and resources required to implement product roadmaps
- Drive continuous advancements within MV electrical designs and communicate technical direction to Sr. Management
- Own and drive the complete product lifecycle from idea conception through implementation and wide-scale deployment to eventual deprecation
- Work independently in a high-pressure environment with all levels of leadership and exercise sound judgment where clear guidelines may not exist

This role works closely with a cross-functional team of Product Design Engineers (PDEs), Product Lifecycle Engineers (PLEs), Structural Engineers, and Technical Program Managers (TPMs). The PM-T partners with PDEs on new product development, collaborates with PLEs on customer engagement and lessons learned, and coordinates with TPMs on first-of-a-kind deployments. The ability to lead across these disciplines without direct authority is critical to success.

Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision. These MV technologies are essential for meeting our customers' expectations for service and value and meeting Amazon's goals for efficiency, speed, and reliability as we continue expanding our data centers at hyper-scale speed. We are a smart team of doers who work passionately to apply advances in data center technology. We will rely on the Sr. PM-T's ability to understand customer needs and build them into the overall product design and strategy. The ideal candidate:

- Is passionate about understanding customers' needs and translating them into MV product requirements
- Has passion for product development, electrical infrastructure design, and medium voltage power distribution equipment
- Is great at solving problems across technical and commercial domains
- Has the ability to lead multiple products and projects at different stages while staying organized
- Earns trust and builds relationships with different stakeholders (e.g., Engineering, Product Development, Finance, Operations, Suppliers)
- Is comfortable addressing and resolving ambiguity
- Recognizes and appreciates diversity of thought and perspectives

Each day the Sr. PM-T will interact with different teams responsible for engineering, product development, finance, integration, and operation of these complex MV technology programs. They prioritize their activities to support data center product development, identify and resolve problems and blockers, and focus on the actions that are most impactful for product success.

This role requires travel of 30%+ to manufacturing facilities, AWS engineering hubs, data center sites, and supplier locations to drive NPI, supplier qualification, and at-scale deployment.

If you meet these qualifications, exude passion, and enjoy the challenge of innovative projects at hyper-scale size, this job is for you!

Key job responsibilities
- Manage and own the roadmap for medium voltage switchgear (MVS) and medium voltage transformer (MVT) products designed for Amazon data centers
- Engage with internal and external Amazon customers and support teams to gain insights and capture critical medium voltage power distribution needs for the business today and in the future

- Coordinate between multiple teams to develop compelling business cases to substantiate business value, define product prioritization, and outline budget and resources required to implement product roadmaps

- Identify and execute cost reduction initiatives across the MV product portfolio through design-to-value, material optimization, and manufacturing process improvements
- Drive continuous advancements and improvements within our data center MV electrical designs, and communicate technical direction to Sr. Management
- Own and drive the complete product lifecycle from idea conception through implementation and wide-scale deployment to eventual deprecation
- Develop product features and deployment strategies to improve profitability and penetration in new applications and use cases

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Technical, AWS Investments
jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides companies of all sizes with an infrastructure web services platform in the cloud (“Cloud Computing”). With AWS you can requisition compute power, storage, and many other services – gaining access to a suite of elastic IT infrastructure services as your business demands them. AWS is the leading platform for designing and developing applications for the cloud and is growing rapidly with hundreds of thousands of companies in over 190 countries on the platform.

Join us in building on AWS, for AWS!

The Sales, Marketing, and Global Services Organizations' AWS Investments team is looking for a passionate, innovative, results-oriented Senior Technical Product Manager to define and drive the strategy and direction for services, making it simpler for our field team to manage, maintain and operate at scale. We will provide products and solutions that help give our talented selling and marketing teams “superpowers” that let them focus on the customer and helping them drive their business. We’re handling massive scale, providing strategic data that drives the AWS business internally, and supporting one of the largest field sales organizations in the world.

About the Team
The AWS Investments team operates at the intersection of technology, finance, and global sales strategy, managing billions in programmatic, contractual, and operational investments that drive AWS customer acquisition and growth worldwide. We build and operate mission-critical financial systems that enable hundreds of investment programs across AWS globally, ensuring compliance, operational excellence, and strategic impact. We simplify and accelerate program creation and management, allowing large enterprises to go-to-market, faster.
The Opportunity
We are seeking an exceptional Senior Product Manager - Technical to own the product lifecycle for interconnected investment management platforms that are fundamental to AWS's go-to-market strategy. This role requires a unique combination of deep technical expertise, financial systems knowledge, and the ability to navigate complex organizational dynamics across AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services.
What You'll Own
You will be the single-threaded owner responsible for managing the complete product lifecycle key of console capabilities within the AWS Investments platform that supporting billions in programmatic and contractual investment through hundreds of programs across AWS globally, enabling deal support, promotional funding, and strategic customer investments.
What You'll Do
Product Strategy & Execution
• Define and own the product roadmap and feature priorities key AWS Investments products, contributing to OP1/OP2 narratives and engineering organization roadmaps
• Manage the complete product lifecycle from concept through delivery, working independently with limited guidance
• Define problems we're solving, desired customer experience, vision, tenets, and product strategy for complex financial systems
• Make smart trade-offs between time, effort, and features while ensuring products meet compliance and operational requirements
• Drive product discussions with executives (technical and non-technical), creating product materials and training content
Technical Leadership
• Understand the end-to-end architecture of Amazon Financial Systems, Payment networks, Commerce Platform, and their integration points
• Define APIs, algorithms, and identify where architectural changes are needed to create the right customer and business experience
• Recognize when technical design limits performance, scale, extensibility, and our ability to innovate for customers
• Articulate when new services are needed (and when they are not), working with engineering teams across organizational boundaries
• Assess emerging technologies and their application to investment management use cases
Cross-Organizational Collaboration
• Work with business stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Global Services, Finance, Legal, and Compliance teams
• Navigate complex integrations with Go-To-Market tools, Salesforce, AWS Marketplace, and core sales processes
• Distill clear requirements from diverse sets of customers, partners, vendors, and regional business entities
• Build consensus across technical and business strategies, aligning stakeholders on approach and prioritization
• Partner with TPMs, engineering teams, and business leaders to ensure cohesive end-to-end solutions
Business Impact & Metrics
• Develop product plans with clear, measurable success criteria
• Define mechanisms and metrics (KPIs, funnels, conversion, awareness) to track product adoption and performance
• Impact product brand, customer experience, technical design trade-offs, and organizational business goals
• Establish and simplify processes to ensure products meet customer needs through effective roadmap prioritization
• Create audit mechanisms for metrics, reporting, and evaluation standards
Risk Management & Compliance
• Proactively mitigate risks and reduce exposure to classic failure modes in financial systems
• Ensure products meet financial, legal, and regulatory requirements across multiple jurisdictions
• Define showstoppers related to product quality, ensuring issues are resolved in the right order
• Manage post-launch support, triage, and issue management for mission-critical financial systems
Basic Qualifications
• 5+ years of engineering, product management, or relevant experience
• Demonstrated experience managing technology products or major features with considerable business impact
• Strong technical understanding sufficient to work credibly with engineering teams on complex systems
• Experience with financial systems, payment networks, or commerce platforms
• Proven ability to handle complex product development scenarios with visible risks, roadblocks, and constraints
• Track record of successfully driving engineering teams to deliver on product vision
• Experience working with cross-functional teams including engineering, finance, legal, and compliance
Preferred Qualifications
• Deep institutional knowledge of Amazon Financial Systems, Payment networks, and Commerce Platform
• Experience with Go-To-Market tools, Salesforce, and AWS Marketplace integrations
• Understanding of AWS sales processes and how they interoperate with data systems and tools
• Experience managing products supporting $1B+ in transaction volume
• Proven ability to influence technical priorities and business strategy through data-driven contributions
• Experience with global compliance requirements and risk management frameworks
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field
• Experience contributing to OP1/OP2 planning processes
• Track record of building consensus across multiple organizational boundaries
• Experience with agile software engineering practices and best practices for full software development lifecycle
Technical Expectations for Senior PMT
• Understands the reasons behind product/feature architecture decisions and can articulate why systems are built certain ways
• Capable of holding engineering teams to high standards for product solutions (similar to a technical manager)
• Recognizes when technical design limits a product's performance, ability to scale, and future innovation capability
• Able to discern which solutions require additional technical guidance from senior engineers or subject matter experts
• Understands the impact of technical backlog on product future and development team execution
• Knows how to prioritize operational excellence work alongside feature delivery on roadmaps
• Can assess emerging technologies and apply them to product/feature use cases
Key Competencies
Scope and Influence
• Manages multiple products with major features
• Influences strategic direction (business and technology) and engineering organization priorities
• Impacts team engineering roadmaps (internal/external), segment adoption, and organizational business goals
Communication
• Drives product discussions including vision, goals, tenets, narratives, MBR/QBR, and status updates with executives
• Contributes to OP1 planning processes
• Creates product materials and sales/training content
• Produces clear, concise documents including PR/FAQs and technical specifications
Execution
• Works to deliver the right product through tactical and strategic approaches
• Defines features, business, and technology strategy
• Aligns stakeholders across complex organizational structures
• Makes smart trade-offs and may own launch/issue response
• Mentors others and performs PMT assessments
Why This Role Matters
The AWS Investments team enables AWS's growth by providing the financial tools and systems that support customer acquisition, retention, and expansion strategies. Your work will directly impact how AWS invests billions of dollars to drive customer success, requiring you to balance technical excellence, financial rigor, compliance requirements, and operational efficiency at global scale.
Amazon Leadership Principles
Success in this role requires strong demonstration of Amazon's Leadership Principles, particularly:

jobs.title: Product Manager, Technical III, External Services, AWS Training and Certification
jobs.description:
As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon's unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers' businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon's real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

Are you excited about defining a new category of software, AI teammates that help people learn and grow in the flow of their work? Do you want to shape how millions of professionals build skills, earn certifications, and get better at their jobs every day? Do you want direct and immediate impact on the way people and AI learn together?

As part of the AWS Training and Certification team, we are building AI learning teammates: agentic systems that don't just answer questions or hand out courses, but work alongside people, notice where they are getting stuck, and turn everyday tasks into moments of learning. Instead of pulling people out of their work to take a class, these teammates bring the right guidance, practice, and credential right into the tools and tasks they already use. This is a new product space where the right experience is still being invented, and we are looking for a product leader who partners deeply with design to define it.

As a Senior Product Manager - Technical, External Services, you will partner with design and lead the development of AI learning teammates, owning the product vision, requirements, and roadmap from concept through go-to-market. You will champion the needs of learners and the organizations that train and certify them, and translate ambiguous, open-ended problems into clear product definitions and detailed business requirements documents. You will work hand-in-hand with design, engineering, science, learning scientists, and operational stakeholders to prioritize the roadmap and spearhead the definition of new capabilities.

This role sits where product, learning, and design meet. A great learning teammate is built on more than a strong model and solid systems. It depends on trust, on clear interaction patterns, and on how it feels to be coached while you work. You will co-own the end-to-end experience with design. That spans how a teammate joins a team, how it surfaces learning in the flow of work, how it recognizes mastery and guides someone toward certification, and how people stay in control of their own development.

The successful candidate must have exceptional problem solving skills, strong business judgment, and demonstrated experience leading cross-functional teams. We are looking for a proven ability to execute both strategically and tactically, and someone who is excited to take on new, ambiguous projects that will be industry defining. This position requires a solid technical background, and the candidate should be customer-focused with a passion for learning, AI, agents, and the future of how skills are built.

AWS Training and Certification helps people and organizations build the cloud and AI skills they need to be successful, from foundational learning through role-based certifications recognized across the industry. As a member of this team, you'll support the development and management of AI-powered learning experiences that reach learners worldwide, including the agentic learning teammates that will define the next decade of how people grow their skills.

Key job responsibilities
- Partner with design to define and own the end-to-end experience for AI learning teammates, from onboarding and interaction patterns to how learning is delivered in the flow of work.
- Define product requirements and author business requirements documents that align engineering, design, science, learning scientists, and leadership around a shared vision for each capability.
- Own the roadmap for one or more learning teammate product areas, making trade-off decisions across competing priorities, customer commitments, and technical investments.
- Represent the product externally with enterprise customers, translating their workforce development and certification needs into product direction and measurable adoption goals.
- Drive cross-team alignment to ensure teammate capabilities are composable and reusable across the learning portfolio, partnering with learning science and certification stakeholders to keep in-the-flow experiences grounded in proven learning principles.

A day in the life
You might start your morning in a design review, working through the interaction model for how a teammate offers a quick coaching moment the instant someone hits a task they haven't done before. By midday, you are reviewing skill-progression and certification-completion metrics and preparing a decision narrative for leadership on a proposed new capability. In the afternoon, you connect with learning scientists and engineering to pressure-test whether an in-the-flow learning experience is effective and feasible this quarter, then close out by refining requirements for the next capability and drafting a narrative that will guide customer-facing conversations.

This person should be customer-obsessed, data-oriented, technologically hands-on, and excited to innovate.

You will be a core member of our product and engineering teams, driving the success of our products, tools, and capabilities to enable our organization to deliver insights and analysis at pace. We work across multiple Amazon Stores categories (e.g., consumer electronics, apparel) and tech teams (e.g., search, personalization), partnering with senior business leaders in strategically developing and improving the shopping experience on Amazon.

As our agentic-powered product suite has rapidly grown in recent months, with ever-increasing demand from users, we are looking for a PM-T who will focus on building and enhancing features of internal products and tools that drive insights and analysis across Amazon, enabling teams globally to improve end-to-end customer experiences.

The immediate objective is to own the vision, design and implementation for our next feature release, which will be a step change in how we evaluate Personalized shopping and streaming experiences worldwide. You will work with users, engineering, and leadership to drive alignment on requirements to ensure the product meets the high bar and provides a delightful experience.

A successful PM-T will be able to deeply understand the user needs, and experiences for features of our products, dive deep into the technical design, identify trade-offs (both back end and front end), surface edge cases, drive decision making, influence, and drive long-term product roadmap and success. The role will also suit someone who enjoys collaborating across our wider suite of products and capabilities to drive impact on high priority business needs.

You should be passionate about improving Amazon’s end-to-end processes and technology, and building partnerships across business and development teams to drive changes. You have the proven ability to dive deep into complex systems and metrics and understand the business context behind the data and technology, continuously striving to find deeper insights. You will be responsible for using innovative technology and seek out best practices.

This role will allow you to make a real impact on our business from Day 1, and provide a dynamic, innovative and fast-paced environment to constantly build your skill set and address new challenges.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the experience and product design for new feature launch and rollout in our product suite.
- Deeply understand user needs and effectively translate into structured product and technical requirements, regularly driving conversations with users and diving deep on their feedback to identify and prioritize high-impact improvements.
- Play a critical role in influencing the vision and product roadmap for the future, write effective PRFAQs and technical requirements, stay at the forefront of technology advancements and push the tech frontier.
- Understand complex business problems across business units, geographies and product lines.
- Manage ambiguity and translate this into tech requirements.
- Effectively partner with users in our team to solve their problems.
- Build strong relations with internal stakeholders to understand priorities, provide inputs to our roadmap and to collaborate and work with them on studies and actions to implement product and service solutions.
- Support hiring and onboarding of new team members and contribute to our high performing culture.
- Work cross functionally with peers/colleagues globally to support best practices, and shared opportunities.

About the team
Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT) is an organization made up of a diverse suite of functions dedicated to deeply understanding and improving customer experience, globally. We are a team of builders that develop products, services, ideas, and various ways of leveraging data to influence product and service offerings - for almost every business at Amazon - for every customer (e.g., consumers, developers, sellers/brands, streamers, gamers). Our team is truly international, with members located in multiple countries around the world, enabling us to bring a global perspective to our work.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager — Billing and Accounting, Amazon Shipping
jobs.description:
Ready to build Amazon's next $100B business? We're not just entering shipping, we're transforming how billions of packages move around the globe. By evolving Amazon's legendary fulfillment engine into an agile, intelligent shipping network, we're creating a system that continuously optimizes to deliver on time, every time, for every business and every customer. Every shipment is more than just a box, it spins the flywheel faster, enhancing our logistics network through scale, speed, and intelligence. As we increase density and reach, we're revolutionizing shipping for all businesses while strengthening Amazon's own delivery capabilities, reducing costs and accelerating deliveries across our entire ecosystem.

WHAT WILL YOU DO?
We're hiring a Senior Product Manager for Billing and Accounting in Amazon Shipping. This role exists to make getting paid effortless and trustworthy for our shippers, and predictable and well-controlled for the business, as we consolidate fragmented, region-specific billing systems into a more standardized flow.

You'll own execution of defined product workstreams across the invoice-to-cash lifecycle: how charges are billed, how invoices are presented, how customers pay, how disputes and adjustments are resolved, and how transactions reconcile to the ledger. You'll drive consolidation of legacy and interim billing systems, close functional gaps, and ensure accurate, compliant, and controlled financial outcomes across every marketplace we operate in. You'll turn complex billing and accounting requirements into clear product definitions, and partner across operations, pricing, payments, credit risk, accounting, tax, and engineering to deliver them.

You'll work at the intersection of finance, operations, and engineering, translating regulatory, accounting, and customer requirements into crisp product requirements, and turning them into billing experiences that scale as the business grows.

You'll collaborate closely with:

-Billing Operations teams who manage day-to-day shipper interactions on invoices, payments, and disputes
-Payments and Credit Risk product owners whose capabilities your billing workstreams depend on
-Pricing teams introducing new charges and rate structures that our systems must bill for
-Accounting teams who own the ledger and require accurate, compliant, and controlled financial records
-Tax (VAT) teams who own compliance and filings
-Engineering teams building the billing and accounting platform
-Senior leadership setting financial strategy and controls for the business

WHO ARE YOU?
You're a product leader who is equally comfortable digging into an invoice reconciliation, writing a crisp product narrative, and walking an accounting or operations leader through a control tradeoff. You have strong product sense and build the right thing, not just build the thing right, within a defined charter. You bring real financial and data fluency, enough to partner credibly with accounting, tax, and finance on controls and compliance, and with engineers on data and systems, and you understand how billing, invoicing, and reconciliation actually get done day to day. You decompose an undefined problem space into a clear, sequenced set of deliverables, define the metrics that matter, and let them guide prioritization. You communicate crisply across functional, operations, and leadership audiences, and you balance a bias for action with the judgment to know a one-way door from a two-way door. You're a strong owner who is right a lot, and you measure success by customer and business outcomes, accurate billing, on-time payment, clean reconciliation, and reduced disputes, not features shipped. You thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where product decisions directly impact billing accuracy, reconciliation, dispute rates, and cash flow across a rapidly scaling business.

Key job responsibilities
Product Execution & Delivery
- Own execution of defined billing and accounting product workstreams within the charter, connecting accurate, frictionless financial experiences to growth and control across the business
- Write the product narratives and requirements that define new capabilities and drive alignment across operations, pricing, accounting, tax, and engineering
- Balance near-term operational and compliance needs with longer-term investment in a consolidated billing platform
- Work with engineering to deliver billing and accounting capabilities into the platform and the tools operations teams use every day
- Make sequencing and scope tradeoffs to deliver impact incrementally while protecting live financial operations
- Define clear acceptance criteria for operational and accounting adoption

Metrics & Business Impact
- Own billing accuracy and reconciliation outcomes as primary success measures, along with supporting measures of dispute rate and days-sales-outstanding
- Establish mechanisms for continuous visibility, baselining, and proactive risk identification
- Quantify the impact of billing and accounting improvements on revenue assurance, cost to serve, and customer trust, and communicate results to leadership

Cross-Functional Influence
- Build alignment across operations, pricing, payments, credit risk, accounting, tax, and engineering through clear narratives and data
- Represent the voice of shippers and operations teams in product decisions
- Drive adoption of new billing and accounting capabilities across regions as systems consolidate

About the team
Amazon Shipping is the parcel shipping arm of Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS), Amazon's portfolio of freight, distribution, fulfillment, and parcel shipping solutions, extending the logistics network built for Amazon's own operations to businesses of all types and sizes.

Billing & Payments sits at the financial heart of that flywheel. Every shipment a customer trusts us to move must be priced, billed, paid, and reconciled accurately, at massive scale, across currencies, geographies, and payment methods. Get this right, and shippers pay with confidence, disputes fall, and cash flows predictably. As Amazon Shipping grows, this team is building the billing and payments foundations that let the business scale without friction.

- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience as a product manager or owner
- Experience delivering billing, invoicing, payments, or other financial-systems products
- Experience delivering billing, invoicing, payments, or other financial-systems products.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Product Manager, Quick Sight - Structured Data Analytics
jobs.description:
Amazon Quick is a decision intelligence service for the AI era. Today, thousands of enterprises and millions of users rely on Quick to connect their data, generate insights, and turn decisions into action — whether through interactive dashboards, embedded analytics woven into the products their customers use, natural language experiences that let any knowledge worker ask a question and get an answer they can act on immediately or fully managed tools that they can build and deploy for their stakeholders. 1000s of ISVs and SaaS companies have already built Quick into the fabric of their applications, powering experiences for millions of end users who benefit from intelligent, data-driven products. That is the kind of reach we operate at — and we are just getting started.

We are now at an inflection point. The convergence of structured data analytics, natural language interfaces, and agentic AI is rewriting the rules of what a decision intelligence service can do — not just for analysts, but for every knowledge worker in an enterprise. Quick sits at the center of this shift. We're building the service that lets an enterprise analyst build a governed dashboard in minutes, an ISV embed AI-powered analytics into their product with a few API calls, and a business leader ask a question in plain English and receive an insight they can turn into action before the day is over. The same service. The same governed data. One experience that scales from a single user to an entire organization — unlocking productivity, surfacing new opportunities, and accelerating businesses that are powered by data.

We are hiring a product leader for structured data analytics product team to own critical parts of this journey. This role spans some of the most consequential product areas in cloud analytics and decision intelligence today:

The data and intelligence foundation — how enterprises bring structured and unstructured data together under a unified semantic and governance layer that powers both BI reporting and AI-driven insights that turn into action.
Embedding and ISV enablement — how thousands of companies build differentiated, analytics-rich products on top of Quick's capabilities, and how we make that experience so seamless it becomes the default choice for every builder.
Business model and growth strategy — how we design packaging, pricing, and adoption pathways that make it effortless for customers to start, experiment, and scale with us — turning first deployments into enterprise-wide commitments.

What unites these roles is a shared profile: a deeply technical product leader who is equal parts strategist and practitioner. Someone who can see the three-year arc of a market and then roll up their sleeves to ship the next release. Someone who works backward from the customer's deployment — not from a requirements document — and who measures their own success by whether the customer succeeded. Someone who sees a nascent, fast-growing business not as a risk but as a canvas.

Quick is a business that is growing, evolving, and actively being shaped by the people on this team. You will have a direct and visible thumbprint on a service that is becoming the decision intelligence layer for enterprises and AI-powered products alike. The decisions you make — about what we build, how we package it, who we build it for, and how we bring it to market — will define how thousands of organizations and millions of knowledge workers experience data, make decisions, and take action in the age of AI.

If you are a builder who gets energy from ambiguity, who thinks in systems but ships in increments, and who wants to be at the frontier of where decision intelligence meets artificial intelligence — we want to talk to you.

Key job responsibilities
- Drive product delivery in deep partnership with engineering, applied science, and design. Drive product specifications, make crisp tradeoff decisions, and ensure high bar on the quality and user experience
- Be hands-on with the technology. Whether that means understanding how a semantic model resolves a natural language query, how an embedded analytics SDK integrates into a partner's React app, or how a pricing SKU flows through AWS billing — you operate at the level of detail where real product decisions are made.
- Own broad customer journeys from first contact through enterprise-wide adoption for critical engagement. Partner with GTM and Sales teams to design onboarding pathways, migration playbooks, and growth motions that reduce friction, accelerate time-to-value, and turn successful deployments into organization-wide productivity gains.
- Engage directly with enterprise customers, ISV partners, and AWS field teams. Turn what you hear into product conviction — not just feature requests, but insight into where the market is moving and what customers will need before they know to ask for it.
- Directly contribute to business outcomes — adoption, revenue, competitive win rates, customer retention. Use data relentlessly to prioritize, to make the case for investment, and to communicate progress to senior leadership.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing customer adoption metrics and operational dashboards, then shift into a working session with engineering and design partners to refine an upcoming feature launch. After lunch, you could be authoring a technical white paper or preparing a strategic narrative for leadership review. Later, you may lead a session with C-suite Data and AI executives on how their enterprise data can be turned into business outcomes using AWS analytics. Throughout it all, you bring clarity to tough trade-offs and ensure every stakeholder has the context they need.

Our team is focused on building and evolving externally facing services that empower businesses of all sizes to succeed. We operate with a strong sense of ownership and collaborate closely with science, research, engineering, design, marketing, and sales partners to deliver AI powered products that customers love and see how they can accelerate business value. We value decisiveness, curiosity, creative problem-solving, and a commitment to raising the bar for one another while being deeply technical and obsess about working backwards from customer problems.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager - Tech, Security and Identity PMM
jobs.description:
Artificial intelligence (AI) is changing both what customers build as well as what they must defend and how they defend it. Autonomous agents now take actions, access data, and call other systems on their own, creating a new security and identity challenge that every enterprise is racing to understand. At the same time, AI is becoming one of the most important tools defenders have. Together, these shifts represent the biggest change in cybersecurity in a generation.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is investing to lead through that shift. We have long set the standard for security of the cloud, and we are building on that foundation in two directions: helping customers secure their AI workloads, agentic applications, and the identities that AI introduces; and delivering a portfolio of AI-powered enterprise security services that use AI and autonomous agents to help defenders work at machine speed.

As a Product Marketing Manager - Tech (PMM) for AWS Security and Identity, you will help define how AWS talks about services used to secure AI and/or how AI is being used in services to secure customer workloads. Help craft narratives at a time when cybersecurity is going through one of the most consequential shifts. You will work backwards from customer needs to influence product strategy. You'll partner with product and go-to-market teams to identify the customers who care most, understand their use cases, develop messaging, and drive marketing initiatives that help them adopt AWS security services with confidence.

If you thrive at the intersection of technology and business strategy, and you want to shape how the world secures the AI era, this role is for you. You will be part of a team that learns together, experiments and iterates, and is building a strong culture along the way.

Key job responsibilities
• Develop product marketing strategies with product management and go-to-market teams, prioritizing how to secure AI and agentic workloads.

• Own positioning and messaging for AWS services and capabilities that secure AI applications, autonomous agents, and/or the human and non-human identities behind them.

• Synthesize data and customer feedback to identify key personas, emerging AI security use cases, and where AWS should invest.

• Execute launch plans for new security and AI security capabilities

• Develop technical content — presentations, demos, and reference architectures — on securing AI and agentic systems on AWS.

• Represent AWS in industry and analyst events showcasing AWS as a leader in security for the AI era.

• Align with technical and business leaders on priority AI security use cases, and drive field enablement for launches and campaigns.

jobs.description:
Trust depends on two things being true at once: that every piece of customer data is governed, controlled, and provably compliant, and that the organization can move fast enough to keep up as products become agentic and ambient. TCI's AI Enablement & Data Governance charter owns both. On the data side, we make data classification, handling, and retention enforceable and provable rather than asserted. On the enablement side, we build the AI-driven automation and internal products that take operational load off the whole organization, so builders spend their time creating trust instead of maintaining it by hand.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager - Technical to own the product vision and roadmap for this work. You will define the internal products, paved paths, and automation that make data governance provable and that measurably reduce operational burden across every charter. You will translate a broad, ambiguous mandate into a clear product strategy, decide what to build and in what order, and turn it into shipped capabilities that other teams adopt because they are genuinely better and faster. This is a technical product role: you will operate close to data systems, enforcement mechanisms, and AI automation, and you will be expected to reason about the architecture and trade-offs, not just the surface. You will work across engineering, science, product, privacy, and legal, and you will influence teams beyond your own to adopt the standards you set.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for the charter's data governance and AI enablement products.
- Define the internal products and paved paths that make data classification, handling enforcement, and retention provable, and make adopting them the easy default for other teams.
- Own the product direction for AI-driven automation that reduces operational burden across charters, and define how its impact on capacity is measured.
- Write the narratives and requirements that align leadership and partner teams, and represent the charter in cross-organization reviews.
- Partner with engineering and science to make build-versus-adopt and automation trade-offs, and to hold governance and compliance guarantees as product requirements rather than afterthoughts.
- Prioritize ruthlessly across a broad surface, balancing compliance obligations, operational-efficiency gains, and partner-team needs.
- Define and track the metrics that prove governance is enforceable and that automation is actually returning capacity, and use them to steer the roadmap.
- Partner with privacy and legal to translate obligations into product requirements that builders can adopt by configuration.
- Influence and align teams beyond your own to build to the standards and paved paths you define.

About the team
Who We Are:
Trust CX Innovations is a strategic innovation team within Amazon Devices & Services that focuses on advancing AI technology while prioritizing customer trust and experience. Our team operates at the intersection of artificial intelligence, privacy engineering, and customer-centric design.

Our Mission:
To pioneer trustworthy AI innovations that delight customers while setting new standards for privacy and responsible technology development. We aim to transform how Amazon builds AI products by creating solutions that balance innovation with customer trust.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years of end to end product delivery experience
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience in regulatory frameworks and policy analysis methodologies
- Experience delivering large, cross-functional, customer facing products
- Experience with explainable machine learning and artificial intelligence methodologies and tools
- Experience analyzing data to make business decisions
Preferred qualifications:
- Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields
- Advanced knowledge of AI/ML systems, AI model evaluation frameworks, and responsible AI implementation
- Deep understanding of privacy technologies (differential privacy, federated learning, etc.)
- Experience with accessibility technologies and standards (WCAG, Section 508, ADA compliance)
- Knowledge of global privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA, etc.) and accessibility compliance requirements
- Experience with large-scale distributed systems and their privacy/accessibility implications

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Product Manager, Trust CX Innovations
jobs.description:
Amazon's devices are moving from responding to what customers say to perceiving the world around them. Echo, Fire TV, Ring, and the next generation of ambient devices increasingly see, hear, and remember so they can be genuinely helpful. That capability only earns a place in the home if customers trust how it handles what it perceives.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own the product vision and roadmap for Ambient Trust. You will define how always-on perceiving devices respect the physical space and the people in it, and you will turn that into shipped customer experiences, from today's early real-time visual features to a broad ambient transparency and control surface across the device fleet. You will work across product, engineering, science, design, hardware, legal, and privacy to make trust a reason customers choose our devices.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the multi-year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Ambient Trust across perceiving surfaces (including voice, vision, and ambient sensing).
- Define the customer experience for ambient transparency and control
- Advance real-time visual understanding experiences from early release toward dependable activation, accuracy, broader device coverage, and proactive, opt-in capabilities.
- Write the narratives and requirements that align leadership and partner teams, and represent Ambient Trust in cross-organization reviews with Product, Hardware, Engineering, Legal, Responsible AI, and Privacy.
- Define the metrics that prove ambient experiences are both trusted and useful, and use them to prioritize.

A day in the life

No two days look the same in this role. You will move between setting long-term product direction and making the concrete calls that keep experiences moving, partnering closely with engineering, science, design, and other teams to turn a hard trust problem into something customers actually feel. You will spend time listening to customers and translating what you learn into priorities, aligning leaders and partner teams behind a clear plan, and making the judgment calls that balance capability, usefulness, and trust. The common thread is that you are the person making sure that as our devices become more capable, customers feel more in control, not less.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Marketing Manager - Tech, Security and Identity PMM
jobs.description:
Artificial intelligence (AI) is changing both what customers build as well as what they must defend and how they defend it. Autonomous agents now take actions, access data, and call other systems on their own, creating a new security and identity challenge that every enterprise is racing to understand. At the same time, AI is becoming one of the most important tools defenders have. Together, these shifts represent the biggest change in cybersecurity in a generation.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is investing to lead through that shift. We have long set the standard for security of the cloud, and we are building on that foundation in two directions: helping customers secure their AI workloads, agentic applications, and the identities that AI introduces; and delivering a portfolio of AI-powered enterprise security services that use AI and autonomous agents to help defenders work at machine speed.

This role sits at the center of that work. As a Senior Product Marketing Manager (PMM) for AWS Security and Identity, you will help define how AWS talks about both a key domain in securing AI and/or using AI to secure, and own the category narrative for a space that is going through one of the most consequential shifts in security. You will work backwards from customer needs to influence product strategy in your domain and partner with product and go-to-market teams to identify the customers who care most, understand their use cases, develop messaging and drive marketing initiatives that help them adopt AWS security services with confidence.

If you thrive at the intersection of technology and business strategy, and you want to shape how the world secures the AI era, this role is for you. You will be part of a team that learns together, experiments and iterates, and is building a strong culture along the way.

Key job responsibilities
* Develop portfolio-level strategy with product management and go-to-market teams, prioritizing how we secure AI and agentic workloads.

* Own positioning and messaging for how AWS secures AI applications, autonomous agents, and the human and non-human identities behind them.

* Synthesize data and customer feedback to identify key personas, emerging AI-security use cases, and where AWS should invest.

* Lead launch strategies and plans — target audiences and marketing channels — for new security and AI-security capabilities.

* Develop technical content — presentations, demos, and reference architectures — on securing AI and agentic systems on AWS.

* Represent AWS in executive briefings, industry events, and analyst interactions as a leader in security for the AI era.

* Align with technical and business leaders on priority AI-security use cases, and drive field enablement for launches and campaigns.
Basic qualifications:
- Knowledge of and experience with cloud infrastructure technologies
- Experience communicating complex ideas to technical and non-technical audiences
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology, a related technical field or equivalent experience
- 6+ years of direct experience working with customers on cloud technology adoption, AND/OR 6+ years of direct experience in cybersecurity, security operations, networking, threat detection, incident response, endpoint, or identity and access management (IAM)
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience developing detailed go to market plans
- Experience demonstrating strong analytical abilities and confidence in the use of data
- MBA, or Master's degree in management, business administration, economics, engineering, marketing
- Experience marketing or working with artificial intelligence, machine learning, or agentic technologies, and an understanding of how they change the security and identity landscape
- Track record of creating compelling technical demonstrations and reference architectures
- Experience presenting to executive-level audiences and industry analysts

You will partner with engineering, science, and design teams building agentic AI systems that understand full conversation context, dynamically render locally-aware creatives, and drive seamless task completion for customers. Upstream Defect Elimination (UDE) is a Senior Leadership Team mission to remove unnecessary cost in Amazon's retail business, anchored to a shared S-Team goal of $5B Cost Out Impact (COI) in 2026, scaling to a proposed $10B in 2027. UDE requires a myriad of mechanisms and we're in search of a Principal Product Manager to lead the development of the software platform portfolio from within the Retail Business Services team to manage all defects.

Retail Business Services (RBS) is the force multiplier team for Amazon's Retail business growth worldwide through three core strategic initiatives: (1) Defect Elimination, identifying cross-all-retail defects at their root cause and driving extirpation to increase margins; (2) Selection, creating and enriching Amazon inventory data increasing gross merchandise sales growth; and, (3) Operational Excellence, to ensure Amazon's retail business is running efficiently and effectively.

RBS evolving a horizontal internal platform complete with a front-end interface to oversee our UDE program; and, we need an experienced Principal Product Manager to own product vision and lead a small, growing team of product managers as a player-coach across our tracking, reporting, identification, and extrapolation products. This role has significantly evolved in last couple of years, with additional products and capabilities expected to be either ramped up or developed.

As the Principal Product Manager, you would own the development life cycle of our UDE platform portfolio spanning defect tracking, reporting. Own the tool which uses AI for defect identification, and extrapolation to enrich defects with root cause, upstream system, and system owner built with an AI-first development philosophy. Moreover, the leader will lead efforts on simplifying underlying data architectures (with help of dedicated BIE team and central Data Engineering team) for ease of usage of these products, while leading the impact assessment capabilities. It is expected for the leader to continue pushing the envelope on thought leadership via 3YP and Annual plans, which aid not just RBS users, but larger Amazon teams in identifying defects, analyzing and root causing them, assess their impact. jobs.title: Product Manager Business Bulk Fulfilment, Amazon Business Operations - Analytics and Tech
jobs.description:
Amazon Business customers buy at a scale most retail systems were never built for: a school district ordering 2,000 chairs, a contractor ordering 900 boxes of fasteners, a hospital restocking an entire floor. Today those orders often arrive as dozens of separate boxes over many days, and we are rebuilding how Amazon fulfills them.
You will own the product roadmap for bulk and large order fulfillment at Amazon Business. The goal is simple to state and hard to build: a customer places one large order, picks one date, and receives it once, in the form factor that fits their dock and their crew. Getting there means changing how Amazon sources, consolidates, packs and ships large orders, working shoulder to shoulder with the engineering teams that own fulfillment planning and fulfillment center operations. This is a builder role with a funded roadmap and direct exposure to senior leaders across Amazon Business, supply chain and operations.

Key job responsibilities
Own the product roadmap for bulk and large order fulfillment, from customer problem through launch and measured outcome.
Write the documents that get the work funded and built: PRFAQs, business requirements documents, and annual and three year planning inputs.
Act as the requirements owner with partner engineering teams in fulfillment planning and fulfillment center technology, not a ticket filer. Negotiate scope, sequence and dependencies directly with their product and engineering leaders.
Define how Amazon consolidates a large order into as few deliveries as possible, including palletized delivery and customer selected delivery dates.
Define how a request for many individual units can be served from cases and pallets of the same product, working through the inventory, receive and pick changes that requires.
Build the case for dedicated bulk fulfillment capacity, including moving product from suppliers to customers without a putaway step.
Replace manual operator work with automation across sourcing, consolidation and promise, and track the reduction.
Own the metrics: deliveries per order, delivery date accuracy, ship cost per unit and contribution profit per unit. Pull your own data and defend your own numbers.

A day in the life
You will spend your day between customers and builders. Mornings often start in the data, checking how last week's large orders actually shipped and where they fragmented. From there it is working sessions with fulfillment planning and fulfillment center engineering teams on requirements, a review with operations leaders on the manual work still left in the flow, and time with Amazon Business sales and customer teams on what large buyers are asking for. You will write often, and you will present what you write to directors and above.

About the team
Amazon Business (AB) launched in the United States in April 2015 with the vision of delivering a comprehensive procurement solution for business customers of all sizes. In the US, AB now serves Fortune 500 companies, hospital systems, local governments, and education organizations. To support AB's mission, the AB Operations team owns end to end customer experience for AB customers right from checkout to final mile delivery and sits under the broader Global Transportation Services (GTS). We are the Single Threaded WW Ops team driving B2B operations, developing products and programs unique to business customers, and enhancing the business delivery capabilities.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager-Tech, Amazon Devices , Marketing Measurement
jobs.description:
Amazon's Devices & Services (D&S) organization builds and markets consumer products used by hundreds of millions of customers worldwide—including Ring, Blink, Alexa, Kindle, Fire TV, and more. Within D&S, the Demand Science & Optimization (DSO) organization is responsible for the science, data, and products that drive pricing, marketing measurement, demand forecasting, and spend optimization across 50+ product lines in 10+ countries.

Today, the vast majority of D&S's marketing and pricing allocation decisions rely on proxy assumptions rather than direct experimental evidence. We are building the Experimentation & Economic Value Platform to change that: a centralized system that connects experimentation across pricing, marketing, and merchandising into causal science and forecasting models, so every investment decision is backed by evidence rather than assumption.

We are seeking a Principal Product Manager-Tech to own this product end-to-end. You will define the conceptual architecture for a suite of interconnected services—experimentation engines spanning pricing, marketing, and economic value measurement, along with a parameter store, experiment registry, and coordination layer—and partner closely with engineering to build them. A critical part of the role is connecting science outcomes to production systems: ensuring that experiment results, model parameters, and causal estimates flow reliably into the downstream decision products that consume them. You will own the product and experimentation roadmap, define success metrics on usage, engagement, and efficiency, build a streamlined intake process, and drive integration with downstream science and business-facing products. This is a high-visibility, high-autonomy role where you will shape how Amazon's largest consumer hardware business makes data-driven decisions.

Key job responsibilities
Define the Conceptual Architecture
• Define and deliver the conceptual architecture for the platform's experimentation engines (pricing, marketing, and economic value measurement), parameter store, experiment registry, coordination layer, and results store
• Define integration points with downstream science models (e.g., incrementality modeling, demand forecasting) and business-facing products (e.g., spend optimization, scenario planning, and emerging optimization products)
• Partner closely with engineering leadership to translate the conceptual architecture into technical designs, and sequence the development roadmap

Own the Product Vision, Roadmap & Prioritization
• Define and drive the product vision, tenets, and multi-year roadmap for the Experimentation & Economic Value Platform
• Own the experimentation intake process, roadmap, and prioritization across pricing, marketing, and economic value workstreams; prioritize science and engineering bandwidth in partnership with DSO Product and Engineering managers
• Define, prioritize, and track product success metrics: platform adoption, usage, engagement, experiment velocity, model calibration improvement, and iROAS gains

Build a Scalable, AI-Augmented Experimentation Product
• Define how AI agents and automated workflows accelerate experimentation design, execution, monitoring, and insights across the full experimentation lifecycle
• Own and deliver experimentation platforms for joint marketing and pricing experiments
• Implement monitoring systems in partnership with data science and software development—covering data quality, statistical significance, and optimization recommendations—across marketing experimentation and economic value refresh processes

Drive Rigorous Experiment Design & Execution
• Translate user stories and business questions into statistically rigorous randomized controlled trials (RCTs) at the geo and user level
• Own experiment prioritization, design quality, and execution standards globally—ensuring consistency across macro experiments (geo-level strategic allocation questions) and micro experiments (platform-native A/B tests optimizing creative, audience, and bid strategies)
• Partner with economists and data scientists to define RCT validity criteria, create reusable design templates, develop power calculation guidelines, and establish quality bars to ensure direct usability by the business

Lead Stakeholder Engagement & Operational Excellence
• Establish regular business reviews with senior leadership (VP+) to communicate platform progress, experiment impact, and investment priorities
• Build a streamlined, trackable intake process that replaces ad-hoc coordination with structured experiment requests, transparent prioritization, and automated scheduling

- 10+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience technical product management
- Experience working directly with engineering teams
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent
