jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Regulatory Intelligence, Safety, and Compliance (RISC) - Sustainability
jobs.description:
Amazon is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the EU Digital Product Passport (DPP) product end-to-end. The DPP is a foundational regulatory obligation under the EU Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation (ESPR) — and a significant strategic opportunity for Amazon. As product owner, you will define the vision and roadmap and translate a fast-moving regulatory landscape into concrete product requirements.
This is a builder role for someone who thrives in ambiguity. The problem space is not fully defined: regulations are still being finalized, harmonised technical standards are emerging, and Amazon’s approach must be invented from first principles. You will set the goals, make the one-way and two-way door calls, and drive clarity across teams that have competing priorities. You will hold an honest tension between what the regulation requires and what creates durable value for customers and the business.
Success looks like: a defensible product strategy grounded in the regulation; a data pipeline and attribute framework that scale across product categories; on-time delivery of mandatory obligations; and DPP data positioned as a reusable asset that unlocks value across Amazon beyond pure compliance.

Key job responsibilities
* Own the DPP product vision, strategy, and roadmap.
* Translate regulation into product requirements.
* Shape the DPP data pipeline alongside engineering.
* Manage stakeholders and communicate with precision.
* Own DPP metrics and reporting.
* Extend DPP value beyond compliance.
* Operate AI-first. Encode product judgment, tenets, and trade-off frameworks into durable, machine-readable artifacts, and use AI to compress research, synthesis, and drafting cycles — owning the outcome and applying judgment to what ships.

About the team
The EU Digital Product Passport team sits within Amazon RISC International and owns Amazon’s response to one of the most consequential product-compliance shifts in the EU. A Digital Product Passport is a structured, verifiable record of a product’s attributes — origin, composition, sustainability, and circularity data — accessible via a data carrier such as a QR code. Under ESPR and its delegated acts, DPPs become mandatory on a rolling schedule by product category, starting with batteries and extending to textiles, toys, and beyond.
Beyond the regulatory mandate, the team is charting how DPP data can become a strategic asset across Amazon — for example, powering Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) eco-modulation, enriching the catalog, and serving as a single source of truth that auto-populates downstream compliance requirements. The person in this role helps define that ambition and turn it into a shippable roadmap.

- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product

- Experience in technical product management, program management or engineering
- Experience owning feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience with end to end product delivery

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager – Device Software , Leo Network Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager - Technical (PMT) to own the software that enables our customers to connect to the Leo Network. In this role, you will define the products and features that connect customers to the Internet, private networks, and the AWS cloud. You will work at the intersection of networking engineering, satellite systems, and customer experience to build software that enables a differentiated customer experience for consumers, enterprises, and the public sector.

This is a high-visibility role that requires deep technical acumen in embedded software, networking, strong product sense, and the ability to influence across engineering, business, and leadership. You will own the device software roadmap from concept through launch, write PRFAQs and technical requirements, and represent the customer in every architectural decision.

Key job responsibilities
Own the end-to-end software stack powering devices for Leo, including embedded software, networking, and fleet management systems.

Define and drive the software roadmap across multiple device families supporting consumers, enterprises, and public sector customers.

Partner with Principal Engineers and SDEs to prioritize and implement security, usability, and performance capabilities for our customer devices.

Write PRFAQs, technical narratives, and requirement documents to secure resources and align leadership on the device software roadmap.

Collaborate with sales, demand management, and capacity management to gather customer requirements and translate them into product features.

Work cross-functionally with the network infrastructure team to align our customer facing product strategy.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

A day in the life
Your morning starts with a review of overnight testing results — checking key indicators that tell us how our devices are working. You notice a pattern and make a note to work with your engineering team to identify a solution that will impact millions of customers.

Mid-morning, you’re in a design review with engineering to debate the architecture of a new feature for enterprise customers. You push for a data-driven approach, proposing a novel solution that enables us to deliver a prototype faster to get additional customer feedback on our direction.

After lunch, you’re on a call with an large customer’s network architect who wants to understand how Amazon Leo antennas work with their existing network infrastructure. You walk them through Leo’s technology architecture, the telemetry we expose, and discuss improvements they’d like us to build.

In the afternoon, you’re drafting the PRFAQ for a new feature. You collaborate with a principal engineer to ensure the technical approach is sound, and align with sales, other PMs, and finance teams on the financial impact. You end the day with a quick sync with the software development leader to review our plan for a major software release.

About the team
The Leo Connectivity Product team is responsible for the end-to-end networking stack that delivers connectivity from customer terminals through the satellite constellation to ground gateways and back to the terrestrial internet. We work across the control plane and data plane services that make Leo a carrier-grade networking provider.

Our team culture values deep technical curiosity, customer obsession, and a bias for action. We operate with a startup mentality inside Amazon — moving fast, iterating on data, and shipping capabilities that directly impact customer experience. We are builders who are energized by the challenge of delivering consistent, high-performance networking from a dynamic constellation of LEO satellites.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe the best products come from teams with varied perspectives and experiences.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience defining and managing products leveraging embedded software, ideally in an RF-based communications system.
- Strong understanding of distributed systems and cloud-based software development.
- Strong understanding of network fundamentals: Ethernet, IP networking, QoS
- Familiarity with TCP/IP routing and switching, networking ASICs and FPGAs
- Track record of writing technical requirements documents, PRFAQs, or product specifications.
- Experience working with multiple engineering teams to deliver complex, distributed systems.
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools
- Experience with satellite communications, LEO networking, or space-based systems.
- Experience with analyzing sampled network performance data and communicating statistical analysis to stakeholders with varying degrees of context.
- Experience in customer-facing technical product role at a cloud provider or telecommunications company.
- Proven ability to influence without authority across multiple engineering and business teams.
- Familiarity with AWS networking services (Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, VPC) and how enterprise customers build hybrid networks.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Buyability & Selection, Retail Operations and Initiatives
jobs.description:
Amazon South Africa is building out its Retail Operations and Initiatives function. This role owns the selection funnel: the path a product takes from being listed to being purchasable, discoverable, and delivered. Every friction point in that path is yours to find and fix. You will define the governance mechanisms, build the automation, and drive the cross-functional accountability that determines whether customers can buy what vendors make available. The model exists in peer markets; you are building it here from scratch with full ownership and direct visibility to country leadership.

Key job responsibilities
Own the end-to-end selection funnel and the weekly diagnostic that identifies where it leaks

Build the buyability defect taxonomy, the intake mechanism, and the triage SLAs from zero

Design and implement governance mechanisms for demand promise accuracy; migrate manual processes to automated, rules-based systems

Translate demand signals, competitive gaps, and funnel data into prioritised actions for Vendor Managers and In-Stock Managers

Partner with data engineering to build the intelligence layer that makes the funnel visible and actionable

Present funnel performance to store leadership; escalate blockers with clear business impact

Embed AI and automation into detection and governance workflows to scale without scaling headcount

A day in the life
Morning: the funnel. Conversion rates, defect queue, aged orders. You triage, escalate, and clear. Mid-morning: governance review with CS and In-Stock Management; you set the rules, they execute. Afternoon: deep in the data with your engineering partner, refining detection logic or reviewing a new dataset that just landed. Late afternoon: the vendor engagement loop; which products have demand but no supply, which suppliers need a nudge, what needs to change structurally. You close the day presenting the weekly diagnostic to leadership. No two days are the same. Most involve data, decisions, and moving something from blocked to buyable.

About the team
Retail Operations and Initiatives (RO&I) is the mechanism factory for Amazon South Africa. We build the scalable systems that remove operational friction from the retail pipeline, liberate commercial teams to focus on growth, and create the conditions for vendors to invest. The function is established in peer markets across Latin America, North America, and Europe. Small team, high ownership, zero tolerance for process debt. If you want to define how a marketplace operates rather than operate within someone else's definition, this is the role.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager - Tech, Amazon Pharmacy
jobs.description:
Join Amazon Pharmacy's Supply Chain team and shape the systems that determine how medications reach patients. You will define product strategy and drive performance for the buying and inventory planning systems at the core of the pharmacy supply chain: procurement systems that decide what to buy and when under expiry and regulatory constraints, inventory planning that sets optimal stock levels across the network, and placement algorithms that position inventory across fulfillment centers. These systems are informed by demand forecasts that predict prescription volume, but your focus is turning that signal into smart purchasing and inventory decisions.
Pharmacy supply chains are unlike retail: demand is primarily driven by prescriptions (not browsing), products expire, controlled substances require compliance layers, and regulations vary by state. Every buying and inventory decision you define and measure operates under these constraints.

We are looking for a dynamic, analytically rigorous Senior Product Manager - Tech to own the product strategy for how Amazon Pharmacy determines optimal inventory levels, decides what and when to buy, simulates network decisions, and identifies unhealthy inventory — with demand forecasting as a key input to those decisions. You will define the problems, shape the solutions, and drive outcomes across these domains — working directly with engineers and scientists building the underlying optimization and ML systems.

Key job responsibilities
- Define the product vision and multi-year roadmap for pharmacy supply chain systems: procurement, inventory placement and capacity planning

- Translate complex supply chain and healthcare constraints (expiry, controlled substances, state regulations) into product requirements that engineering teams can build against

- Design and own the end-to-end metrics framework for pharmacy supply chain health within your domain

- Work with Operations, Compliance, Vendor Management, Fulfillment, Finance, and In-Stock partners to provide solutions and drive improvements

- Partner with Applied Scientists and ML Engineers to define success criteria for forecasting models, optimization algorithms, and automated decision systems

- Influence without authority across multiple teams and organizations to drive outcomes in a matrixed environment
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in engineering, statistics, computer science, operations research, business analytics, information systems or equivalent

We work across multiple Amazon Stores categories (e.g., consumer electronics, apparel) and tech teams (e.g., search, personalization), partnering with senior business leaders in strategically developing and improving the shopping experience on Amazon.

As our agentic-powered product suite has rapidly grown in recent months, with ever-increasing demand from users, we are looking for a PM-T who will focus on building and enhancing features of internal products and tools that drive insights and analysis across Amazon, enabling teams globally to improve end-to-end customer experiences.

The immediate objective is to own the vision, design and implementation for our next feature release, which will be a step change in how we evaluate Personalized shopping and streaming experiences worldwide. You will work with users, engineering, and leadership to drive alignment on requirements to ensure the product meets the high bar and provides a delightful experience.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager- Technical, WW Ops Finance S&A
jobs.description:
As a Senior Product Manager-Technical in WW Ops Finance Standardization & Automation, you will lead the vision, roadmap and execution for a combined charter spanning both data management/governance and data consumption by finance routines. We don't build data — we manage and govern it. Data management and governance is the critical function that ensures a trustworthy, reliable supply of data: the oxygen for the entire Amazon Stores Finance organization.

You will own the products that govern how finance data is standardized, certified, and made trustworthy (data platforms, metrics, governance) AND the products that let finance routines consume that governed data at scale — including reporting and financial bridging (variance analysis, carve-outs, plan-vs-actual composition). Applying AI to data management and governance is an exciting frontier for this role: you'll tackle the hard problem of extracting semantic meaning from a multitude of data ecosystems that often lack proper documentation, and translating that into use-case-specific, trustworthy datasets and metrics — a frontier with significant room to invent and evolve. You will partner with other Product Managers, Finance partners, Business Intelligence (BI) Managers, Data Engineers, Business Intelligence Engineers (BIEs), and Technical Program/Product Managers (TPMs) to understand inputs from multiple internal and external sources and develop a product vision and strategy that connects the governed data layer directly to the finance routines that depend on it.

We have a strong vision and are iterating rapidly with incremental value to our customers — this role carries a highly visible charter and strategic significance, spanning the full arc from data governance to finance-routine consumption. This comes with a lot of opportunities to develop/launch a new suite of technical product capabilities to govern our data ecosystem and the services built on top of it, and to grow as a product leader.

About you
You’re an accountable, hands-on product leader with a strong focus on problem solving with a positive attitude, who lets nothing stand in the way. You know how to clarify the path forward and prioritize work while dealing with ambiguity and limited data points. You know how to influence others. You’re a natural collaborator equally comfortable talking business process with operation leaders, tech with developers, user experience with designers, positioning with product marketers, numbers with finance and marketing, and strategy with executive leadership. You stay the course on your vision, but remain flexible in how you achieve it, keeping overall success and incremental value to your customers in mind.

- Be the ultimate owner of the product vision, strategy and execution across both the data governance layer (standardization, certification, metrics, metadata) and the consumption layer (reporting, financial bridging, and routine-level data delivery).
- Champion the application of AI to data management and governance — extracting semantic meaning and lineage from sprawling, often-undocumented data ecosystems, and translating that into trustworthy, use-case-specific datasets and metrics finance teams can rely on. - Create and manage a unified roadmap, prioritization framework, entitlement model, and success metrics that connect data governance directly to finance-routine outcomes (e.g., faster bridge delivery, self-service reporting, reduced manual reconciliation).
- Define how finance routines (WBR, MBR, MEC, planning) consume governed data — including bridging/carve-out logic, drill-down grain, and dimension inheritance — in partnership with the data governance roadmap. - Recruit customers to be part of advisors, share roadmap with customer stakeholders and partners across both data producer/steward and finance-routine consumer audiences.
- Design and implement new processes to delight Finance customers at scale, from data producers and stewards through finance analysts to leadership consumers. - Implement and manage a Product/Program Management framework that ensures completeness of requirements and communication with stakeholders through scalable mechanisms such as business reviews, news flashes, and dashboards.

A day in the life
As a Product Leader in S&A, you are empowered to make data-driven decisions, articulate your vision and sell your features for implementation. You are expected to articulate your point of view with crisp communication, demonstrate ability to synthesize the inputs from your partners and stakeholders, and achieve alignment in harmonious way. You will proactively manage product backlog and work closely with your tech team and TPMs to ensure deliveries that deliver both value and take the product towards S&A North Star vision.

We don't build data — we manage and govern it, ensuring a trustworthy, reliable supply of data that is the oxygen for the entire Stores Finance organization. Our products span both how finance data is governed and how it is consumed by finance routines, supporting automation and standardization of planning, reporting, and financial bridging (variance analysis, carve-outs, and plan-vs-actual composition). jobs.title: Sr. Product Marketing Manager, AI Studios
jobs.description:
Shape the future of cinematic storytelling: for creators, by creators. We're seeking a founding Product Marketing Manager to own how the industry understands our GenAI-enabled creative platform — built at Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios to help professional creators bring animation, live action, and VFX content to screen. AI Studios is a fast-growing team operating as a startup within Amazon, with direct ownership of studio-level goals.

You will build the product marketing function for AI Studios' content creation platform from the ground up and own its strategy end to end. You are accountable for how our platform is positioned, differentiated, and understood at scale — the narrative, competitive positioning, and market brand that drive awareness and demand across Amazon MGM Studios, AWS, and the broader creative industry. You will operate with independence in a space where the long-term strategy is not yet defined, set the marketing strategy, and bring the data-driven judgment to make the hard positioning trade-offs. The single most important thing you bring is credibility in the AI content-creation industry: you know the tools, you have made content with them, and you can hold your own in any room — with the best creators and filmmakers, and with the most skeptical executives.

Key job responsibilities
As AI Studios' founding Principal Product Marketing Manager, you will define and own the product marketing strategy for the platform, with long-term impact on how it is perceived across the industry. You will:

- Own the platform's core positioning and value proposition — the messaging and go-to-market narrative that define what it is, who it's for, and why it matters — so customers and partners understand it clearly and consistently.
- Own competitive differentiation: track a fast-moving landscape, articulate where we lead and where we are heading, and evolve the story as the market and our capabilities change.
- Aggregate and synthesize signals — competitive intelligence, customer and creator needs, industry and model trends — into a coherent marketing strategy and point of view that others build on.
- Build the definitive narrative and asset portfolio, versioned for distinct audiences (executive, artist and creative, technical and model-focused) and kept current with our latest capabilities, so the organization is always ready to represent the platform at its best.
- Drive awareness and demand across internal Amazon (Prime Video, Amazon MGM Studios, AWS, AGI, etc.), converting broad interest into a durable pipeline of engagement rather than one-off scrambles.
- Represent the platform credibly in high-stakes rooms — and equip senior leaders with the framing, competitive answers, and visual aids they need to carry the story themselves.
- Partner with Business Development and go-to-market teams to shape how the platform is positioned for the customer segments it serves over time.
- Create the mechanisms that let product marketing scale as the function grows, force-multiplying your impact through creative partners and the broader team rather than producing everything yourself.
- Collaborate closely with your cross-functional counterparts, including Product Management, UX Design, Engineering, Applied Science, and Creative teams to understand and inform the direction of our product suite.

A day in the life
Your morning starts with a request from leadership for a tailored pitch ahead of an executive meeting — and because you own a current, coherent narrative, you turn it around without pulling anyone off their day job. You sync with a creative lead to capture a fresh demo and usage anecdotes, then sharpen the competitive framing on where the platform leads and where it is heading. After lunch, you prep a model-focused cut of the story with Science for a technical audience and a VP-level cut for an upcoming review, and align with Business Development on how the positioning maps to their go-to-market. You field inbound interest from another team and fold it into the demand plan. You close the day evolving the differentiation story against the latest competitor release. Throughout, you're the person who owns how the industry sees what we're building.

About the team
AI Studios is a small, high-ownership "startup within Amazon," formed by Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios to build multimodal AI tools and models for content creation with human's in the driver's seat. We work directly with professional filmmakers, animators, and VFX artists on active productions. We operate from first principles, learn directly from working creators on real productions, and hold a high bar for craft, safety, and storytelling magic. If you're motivated by invention and inspired by storytellers, this is your seat at the table.

- 6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience leading go-to-market for consumer software or hardware product launches
- Experience prior success in driving execution of large-scale project plans with multiple teams in support of business goals
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience with customer segmentation, profiling, and targeting
- Hands-on fluency creating content with generative-AI tools
- Experience and credibility in the AI content-creation or media-production industry

jobs.description:
Amazon Optics operates the physical security infrastructure that protects the most sensitive computing environments on Earth: AWS data centers, Amazon corporate offices, and Leo ground stations. We manage more than 600K access control devices and 300K cameras. We integrate video management, access control, and intrusion alarming into one platform, and we strengthen it with AI analytics. Our job is to make every physical space Amazon operates continuously understood, proactively protected, and programmatically extensible.

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager - Technical (PM-T) to own the holistic product strategy for Optics, own its profit and loss (P&L), and drive the platform toward the future state.

You will own the product narrative for the entire Optics platform, comprised of divisions for access control technology, incident response, video surveillance and analytic capabilities. You will
define the product strategy that replaces a fragmented customer ecosystem with an automated, extensible platform, and you will sequence the investments that get us there.

You will make sure Optics serves its internal customers first while shaping the platform foundations that keep our longer-term options open. You will partner directly with the Optics organization leader, with directors and VPs across our customer organizations, and with security and infrastructure leaders throughout Amazon. You will operate where product strategy, physical security, and platform architecture meet.

The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who is comfortable with deep technical ambiguity, fluent in translating customer problems into product requirements, financially literate enough to own a P&L and defend a cost model, and credible with both principal engineers and VP-level stakeholders.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the product strategy and roadmap for the Optics platform
- Own the Optics P&L and the financial narrative
- Shape the market offering
- Represent the voice of the internal customer
- Own the platform strategy that lets customers move at their own pace
- Own the resource allocation model between platform and features
- Establish the responsibility contract with customers
- Write the narratives that align the organization
- Define and own the metrics that measure product and business success
- Raise the product bar for the organization

A day in the life
Your days blend deep strategic work, customer discovery, financial modeling, and cross-organizational partnership. No two look the same, but a representative day includes:

Morning - You block your first hours for the work that needs uninterrupted focus: drafting the product strategy narrative for an upcoming leadership review.

Mid-morning - You meet with your finance partner to pressure-test the P&L and refine the cost-per-site model, reconciling the savings that our first-party hardware and quantifying the opportunity cost of deferring the platform investment another quarter.

Afternoon - You meet with a director from a customer organization and a peer leader from an adjacent Amazon infrastructure team.

Late afternoon - You review the platform's product and business health metrics. Cost per site is trending the right way. You draft the mechanism to track it so the signal reaches the right people to make business decisions, and close the loop with engineering to ensure the target goal is achieved.

About the team
Amazon Optics develops the software that gives security operators actionable situational awareness in the physical domain. Our vision is simple and ambitious: Anticipate threats. Redefine physical security. Build a safer world. We build simple, scalable systems that automate safety and security, giving security operators the tools to measure and monitor their environment.

We are the singular enterprise security product that integrates the three core sectors of physical security into one platform: video management, access control, and intrusion alarming and perimeter protection. We strengthen all three with AI analytics. We eliminate hard dependencies on third-party and disparate systems, so our customers get a cohesive, flexible solution and never need intricate knowledge of the systems underneath to get value from what we build.

We protect the environments that matter most: customer data, cryptographic material, and the people who work alongside them. We do it at a scale no one else operates, and we build the cloud infrastructure it runs on. That combination is our right to win. We solve our own hardest problems first, at a scale that makes the solution durable and the economics compound.

Culturally, we are a team that leads with people. We invest in growth, we celebrate wins by name, and we make sure everyone has a voice. We value builders who bring warmth alongside backbone, who can disagree and commit, and who care as much about developing the people around them as about shipping the product. We move fast, we hold a high bar, and we protect a sustainable pace while we do it. If you want to own the product strategy and the economics for a platform that protects Amazon's most critical spaces, and you want to do it on a team that will invest in you, this is the place.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager, AICE - AI Center of Excellence
jobs.description:
The AI Center of Excellence builds shared AI building blocks - primitives - that change how Amazon's systems work, not what features they ship. We take on the hardest problems first, prove each primitive with one partner on one real problem, then open it up so any team at Amazon can adopt what we've validated without solving it again.

We are looking for a Product Manager - Technical who can own the vision and lifecycle of these primitives, drive them from concept through adoption, and make sound product and technical trade-offs in a fast-moving AI domain.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the product lifecycle for AI primitives end-to-end - from customer discovery and problem framing through vision definition, roadmap prioritization, execution with cross-team dependencies, launch, and post-launch performance optimization

- Define product strategy by understanding problems that cut across multiple teams and personas - translating that into clear principles, requirements, and roadmap priorities that sequence work on evidence

- Drive adoption by partnering with early adopters, generalizing requirements from multiple contexts, and ensuring primitives work for any team without requiring your team to operate them

- Evaluate technical proposals alongside scientists and ML engineers - understanding architecture trade-offs and balancing feature delivery with system health and long-term maintainability

- Make crisp product decisions in ambiguous AI/ML domains where the problem and strategy may not yet be defined - using data, customer insight, and judgment

- Define success criteria that measure the primitive you own, not the partner's business outcome you don't - distinguishing adoption from real impact

- Ensure primitives are findable, adoptable, and valuable - not just built and opened

- Contribute to the team's rhythm of business - planning cycles, business reviews, goal tracking, and operational reporting

A day in the life
Every day brings new challenges. You might work backward from a partner team's pain point to frame a new primitive, review a technical design with scientists to assess whether an architecture can scale, or analyze adoption data to decide what to double down on versus deprecate. Other days, you'll write a vision document for a new capability, find new opportunities across the enterprise, or sit with early adopters to understand how they'd consume a primitive in their pipeline. You'll move between technical discussions with scientists and engineers and alignment conversations with senior managers and directors.

No two weeks look the same. You'll move between customer discovery, technical strategy, and hands-on execution - always building toward primitives that are trusted, consumable, and impactful at scale.

About the team
AICE is a team of scientists and machine learning engineers building the AI primitives that power Amazon's intelligent systems. We develop and harden reusable capabilities for broad consumption by product teams across the enterprise - and partner with those teams to integrate them.

Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add-on subscriptions such as Apple TV+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Do you want to invent, disrupt and redefine what entertainment means for fans, creators, and communities all around the globe?

As part of the Prime Video team, you’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. Also, you’ll get to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented creatives, technologists, marketing professionals and so much more, you can decide where a career with Prime Video takes you!

Prime Video's Partner Experience team builds the platform that 10,000+ content partners depend on to deliver, promote, measure, and grow on Prime Video. We're looking for a Technical Sr. Product Manager to identify and own our highest-leverage partner-facing product opportunities, from zero to one.

This is a high-autonomy role for someone who thrives in ambiguity. You define the roadmap. You'll find the biggest unsolved problems for partners and customers, build conviction around the solution, and ship it. One quarter that might mean defining how partners monetize and measure content through ads; the next, extending platform capabilities to entirely new partner verticals. What stays constant is the expectation you move fast, go deep, and deliver outsized impact.

You are deeply curious, the kind of product leader who digs into partner economics, content supply chains, and ad tech with equal enthusiasm. You're comfortable representing Prime Video directly to senior partner stakeholders and translating their needs into products that scale.

Key job responsibilities
Meet directly with content partners to understand their business models, pain points, and growth ambitions; then translate insights into scalable product strategies.

Operate as a "builder PM": conduct deep partner discovery, frame the opportunity, define the product vision, build and test user experiences, drive cross-functional execution from 0 to 1.

Speak the language of developers; dive into data, logs, or basic code concepts to unblock your team and accelerate delivery.

Define success metrics, instrument them, and use data to iterate rapidly and make crisp prioritization decisions.

Represent Prime Video externally at partner meetings, industry forums, and executive reviews; positioning us as the most innovative and transparent distributor in streaming.

Leverage AI/ML and emerging technologies to accelerate discovery, prototyping, and delivery.

Influence product and engineering roadmaps without direct authority, building alignment through compelling narratives and data-driven proposals.

- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 3+ years of end to end product delivery experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience managing technical products or online services
- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience working directly with engineering teams
- Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
- Proven hands-on experience building, launching, or scaling applications using applicative AI, LLMs, AI agents, or AI-assisted IDEs.
- Portfolio of side projects, internal tools, or MVPs built using modern "vibe coding" or AI-augmented development stacks.

Are you passionate about building intelligent financial systems that protect and empower millions of businesses? Do you want to lead a team at the intersection of AI and complex risk management while growing the next generation of product leaders?

The Amazon Business Payments (ABP) team provides invoicing, working capital, and payment acceptance solutions to Amazon Business customers, sellers, and other small business customers across Amazon. We are part of the global Amazon Payments organization, which aims to delight our customers by building payment experiences and financial services that are trusted, valued, and easy to use from anywhere in any way.

Within ABP, the Credit and Fraud Risk Management team drives credit and fraud decisions for our Business Credit account product with the objective of maximizing credit access, minimizing losses, reducing friction, and maintaining a healthy balance sheet. We are entering a transformative era where Generative AI, large language models, and autonomous AI agents are fundamentally reshaping how we manage risk.

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Product Management Technical to own the strategic vision and multi-year roadmap for our next-generation credit and fraud risk platform while building and leading a high-performing product management team. This is a high-ambiguity leadership role where you will define the problem space, set the vision, and architect AI-native product solutions. You will lead through your team, coaching managers and individual contributors to deliver innovation through Generative AI and AI agents that create step-function improvements in efficiency, accuracy, and customer experience.

You will partner closely with Science, Engineering, Portfolio Management, Operations, and business teams across multiple organizations to deliver transformational credit and fraud capabilities. This role requires deep technical judgment, the ability to influence senior leaders across Amazon Payments, Amazon Business, and Seller Partner Services, and a proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent.

- Define and own the 3–5 year strategic product vision and roadmap for credit and fraud risk management, aligning your team's priorities to measurable outcomes across a multi-billion dollar lending portfolio.

- Drive innovation through Generative AI and AI agents by identifying use cases where foundation models, autonomous agents, and intelligent automation can transform credit decisioning, fraud detection, and risk operations.
- Set the technical product strategy for how AI capabilities integrate into credit and fraud systems, partnering with Science and Engineering leaders to evaluate emerging architectures and shape trade-offs that preserve long-term strategic flexibility.
- Influence strategic direction across multiple organizations including Payments, Amazon Business, and Seller Partner Services through clear written narratives and executive forums, while establishing metrics frameworks that measure the effectiveness of AI-driven risk decisions.

You start many mornings reviewing your team's written proposals or experiment results, providing feedback that sharpens their thinking before broader reviews. Mid-morning might bring a working session with your Science and Engineering counterparts to evaluate a new AI agent prototype for fraud detection. Later you may draft or review a strategic narrative for senior leadership that lays out the next phase of your platform roadmap, then close the day syncing with your managers on priorities and blockers across the team.

We combine advanced machine learning, Generative AI, and deep domain expertise to maximize credit access for businesses while protecting Amazon's balance sheet. Our team operates at the intersection of product, science, and engineering, and we are investing heavily in AI-native capabilities that will define the future of automated risk management. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Just Walk Out (JWO) enables shopping in retail stores with no lines and no checkout. You simply use a credit card to enter the store, take what you want from our selection of fresh, delicious meals and grocery essentials, and leave the store. This checkout-free shopping experience is made possible by Just Walk Out Technology, which automatically detects whether products are taken or returned and enables shoppers to grab and go from stores ranging from small airport kiosks to massive university stores.

The Merchant In-Store Operations team within JWO owns the tools, systems, and workflows that enable merchants and their store associates to operate autonomous retail environments at scale. The role spans directly working with two engineering teams that are responsible for unattended store operations, planogram and product layout tooling, and in-store associate experience and education. Together, these teams serve JWO's growing global footprint, supporting diverse retail configurations—from fully staffed locations to completely unattended kiosks and micro-markets—enabling merchants across Sports, Education, Travel, Healthcare, and Hospitality verticals to run Just Walk Out stores efficiently and confidently. This Senior Product Manager-Tech will own the product vision spanning both teams, defining how merchants and store teams interact with, monitor, and maintain their autonomous retail environments day to day and how customer support and tech operations teams diagnose and resolve issues at speed.

You will define the product roadmap spanning two engineering teams—In-Store Operations—covering unattended store operations, store associate tooling, planogram management, store availability, and customer support experience capabilities that scale from hundreds to thousands of stores with vastly different operational models. We work closely with product, engineering, applied science, business development, and marketing teams across Amazon to make sure Alexa+ works even better for Japan than it does in any other locale. The decisions you make will reach millions of customers across Japan.

Alexa+ is the next generation of Alexa, rebuilt on large language models. We are bringing it to customers in Japan, and this is a rare opportunity to shape how a world-class AI assistant works in one of the most demanding and quality-conscious markets.

We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager to own a core part of the Alexa+ experience in Japan. You will own the roadmap for your product area, decide what needs to be built and in what order, and hold the bar for what a good experience looks like for Japanese customers.

Part of holding that bar is defining it: you will build the test cases that specify how the product should behave across the range of things Japanese customers ask for. When something does not work, you will dig into it yourself — reproduce the issue, narrow down where it breaks, and work with engineers and scientists to scope the fix.

You will spend time on which problems are worth solving, how to solve them, and what is needed to convince the right stakeholders to invest. This role suits someone who is comfortable with ambiguity, fluent enough technically to hold their own in a design review, and native in Japanese. You do not need a background in linguistics or machine learning research. You do need strong product judgment and the willingness to get into technical and linguistic details.

• Own the product roadmap and requirements for your area. Define the customer experience, write the specs and PR/FAQs, and set the success metrics.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager Tech, Operations Infrastructure Services
jobs.description:
Amazon's Operations Infrastructure Services (OIS) team is building the unified self-service experience that manages networking, compute, and devices across 3,000+ global operations sites from fulfillment centers to delivery stations and grocery stores, processing millions of daily orders. The OIS Product Suite is the unified entry point across a portfolio of independently operated managed services, analogous to AWS.com, enabling solution teams to provision and manage infrastructure without manual intervention.

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager Technical to own a managed service within our product suite. This is a greenfield opportunity to set the product direction for how Amazon's operations infrastructure is managed for the next decade, at the intersection of software-defined services, physical operations, and emerging agentic AI systems.

Key job responsibilities
Own the end-to-end product vision and roadmap for a managed service within the OIS Product Suite, from initial PRFAQ through launch, defining which infrastructure capabilities the service should expose for self-service and which should remain manually operated in the near term.
Define the service's contract with the rest of the product suite, including the integration standards and data boundaries that determine where your service ends and the next managed service begins, so solution teams get a consistent experience across the portfolio.
Drive elimination of manual intervention in your service's provisioning and management flows, using escalation and rejection data to find where solution teams get stuck and prioritizing the fixes that convert the most manual work into self-service.
Partner with engineering to translate product direction into shippable design, reviewing technical tradeoffs, sequencing the roadmap against the team's capacity, and making build versus buy or build versus defer calls.
Set the policy for where agentic AI can act on your service's behalf, deciding which operations are safe to hand to an agent, which still require a human in the loop, and how that boundary shifts as the underlying physical operations and agentic systems mature.

A day in the life
You spend most of your time at the intersection of product strategy and hands-on technical work. A typical day might start by walking your own self-service flow the way a solution team would, then reading the escalation queue to see who gave up and asked a human instead. From there you might jump into a whiteboard session with engineers debating where your service's contract ends and the next managed service in the suite begins, or writing the PRFAQ that decides which capabilities belong in the product at all. And you will regularly find yourself deciding which of those capabilities should still require a human in the loop and which are ready to be handed to an agent, because that boundary is still yours to define.

We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to focus on go-to-market strategy, product positioning, and creating compelling content for Amazon WorkSpaces. You will combine marketing craft with product depth to define how WorkSpaces shows up in the market, create content that earns trust with technical and executive buyers, and drive launches that build preference and pipeline. jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager — Tech, Amazon LEO, Amazon Leo
jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager – Tech to own the roadmap, and end-to-end delivery for Leo’s critical product experience validation team within Amazon LEO. You will be the single-threaded owner for subject matter expertise in one or more specific areas (e.g., Finance, Accounting, Tax) of Amazon LEO’s eCommerce experience. You work backwards from customer needs to ensure LEO’s product experience meets the cross-functional capabilities at launch and contribute to Amazon Leo’s existing AI-powered Agentic UAT framework. You will work with engineering, other product teams, stakeholder teams (Finance, Tax, Accounting, etc.) and operations teams to deliver your charter.
The products you own sit at the intersection of satellite telecommunications, subscription commerce, and global operations where customer expectations for simplicity collide with the technical complexity of delivering connectivity from space. You will thrive in this environment because you bring genuine product understanding paired with technical depth: you understand how customers think about payments, subscriptions, eCommerce, and reverse logistics when they buy an internet service. You engage meaningfully in engineering discussions, and you apply your product instinct to ensure that the product UAT team can test against product requirements without interpretation. You also influence the existing Agentic Product experience tooling used by the team.

You will work directly with Finance, Legal, Accounting, Tax and Trade (FLATT) stakeholders to understand their requirements, validate product direction, and ensure that every roadmap decision is grounded in real-world need and not on internal assumption. You will author the burndown plans and review the UAT test cases that set the strategic direction of Amazon LEO’s product experience, and you will stay engaged through delivery to ensure what ships matches what was envisioned. In its current phase, Amazon LEO demands someone who can hold both the customer-back strategic view and the technical trade-off conversations simultaneously.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the product experience end-to-end. what LEO builds based on customer needs, and technical feasibility. You develop subject matter expertise, own the "what" and "why" and not just the backlog.
• Drive product strategy across customer segments. Define and analyze subscription lifecycle models, pricing and packaging strategies, and appropriate KPIs for different customer segments, whether consumer, enterprise, or government. Use data to validate assumptions, refine positioning, and inform prioritization.
• Engage directly with customers and technical teams. Spend time with customers to understand how they experience connectivity challenges. Contribute meaningfully to engineering and business discussions around eCommerce workflows, technology decisions, system architecture, and implementation trade-offs. Your product judgment improves because you're fluent in both the customer reality and the technical constraints.
• Work backwards from customers with rigor and craft. Author business requirements that translate complex customer and market needs to transform product validation into agentic experiences. The bar is that your documents are the definitive source of truth — clear enough to align executives, specific enough to drive sprint planning, and compelling enough to earn resourcing.
• Lead executive-level prioritization and planning. Represent and advocate for diverse customer needs during leadership reviews. Present data-driven analysis, frame strategic trade-offs, and make clear recommendations. Every executive touchpoint should produce a decision, not just awareness.
• Drive cross-functional execution without ambiguity. Partner with engineering, operations, legal, compliance, marketing, and business development to establish timelines, define integration paradigms across multiple systems, and drive launch readiness. You don't hand off requirements and hope — you stay accountable through delivery.
• Define success metrics that matter. Establish KPIs and SLAs that reflect genuine customer outcomes and business health — not vanity metrics. Track adoption patterns, analyze product-market fit signals, and use insights to continuously refine strategy and prioritization. Report results to senior leadership with precision and context.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

A day in the life
You start with a morning cadence call with your stakeholders to discuss the scope of a new workstream to validate the launch of Leo in a new country, or new feature set. You use your knowledge and understanding of Leo’s systems and eCommerce capabilities to probe whether the feature product owners have defined complete and accurate test cases to validate features covering your functional area. You influence multiple product leaders to critically think about the feasibility, and testability of their features.
Next you may meet with your FLATT stakeholders, to unblock the validation team regarding a complex, multi-feature test scenario and educate the stakeholder and learn about nuances of the product experience. Then you transition into a discussion with engineering on how a service feature should be tested across geographies. Later, you could be authoring a working backwards document that introduces a new feature in the Amazon Leo Agentic UAT system. You'll collaborate across business development, network engineering, regulatory, and operations teams — navigating the unique challenge of building products where the network is in orbit, the customers are global, and the experience must feel as simple as flipping a switch.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience owning feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
- 5+ years of technical product management experience owning delivery, stakeholder management, and product implementation
- Experience owning a product area in at least one of the following domain areas: Finance, Tax, or Accounting.
- Experience managing technical products or online services at scale
Preferred qualifications:
- MBA
- 5+ years of developing, negotiating and executing business agreements within the telecommunications sector experience
- Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment
- Deep understanding of customer needs for modern telecommunication services — particularly within high-scale fixed, wireless, or satellite broadband services
- Experience defining subscription lifecycle models, market strategies, and KPIs for multi-segment products
- Experience using analytical tools and data analysis to surface product insights and inform strategic decisions
- Track record of authoring high-quality working backwards documents and business requirements documents that drove successful product launches

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Tech, Security Compliance and Engineering
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Principal Product Manager Technical to own the direction of a portfolio of security products with company-wide security, risk, and compliance impact, and to own one of those products directly.

You will define how our products come together: where each one begins and ends, which capabilities belong where, and what the single experience looks like for a builder or a security team moving across them. You will also hold the product function for our most widely adopted product, so the portfolio direction stays anchored to a real backlog rather than becoming strategy at a distance.

This role operates where the business opportunity and the product strategy are not yet defined. You will often need to establish what the problem is before proposing what to build. You will influence engineering priorities, partner-team roadmaps, and security strategy across multiple VP organizations, without owning those teams.

Key job responsibilities
• Own portfolio direction. Define how the products relate to each other, where capabilities belong, and what we stop doing. Make the calls on whether a new capability extends an existing product or justifies a new one.
• Own a flagship product. Hold the product function for one product directly, including the roadmap and the ranked backlog as single prioritizer.
• Define strategy where none exists. Establish the problem, the customer, and the multi-year direction in spaces that are ambiguous today, and bring clarity others can execute against.
• Influence across organizations. Build the partnerships our products depend on across security, compliance, legal, and builder-tooling teams in other VP organizations, and reach agreement on approach and sequencing without authority.
• Set the measurement bar. Define what outcome we are moving and hold the portfolio to it, replacing activity metrics with evidence that security posture improved.
• Develop the product function. Raise the bar on product management practice on the team, mentor product and program managers, and participate in hiring.

A day in the life
You will move between horizons. In the same day you may resolve a boundary question between two products, review a specification with a senior engineer, and reset expectations with a partner team whose roadmap ours depends on.
You will spend meaningful time outside our organization, because most of what limits us is a dependency or a relationship we have not built yet. You will write the documents that make ambiguous, contested decisions reviewable by senior leadership, and you will own the outcome of those decisions.

About the team
We are a team of product managers, program managers, engineers, and security engineers building the products that make security the default rather than a gate. Our portfolio spans three things: preventing issues at the point code is written, assuring that controls are implemented and evidenced, and turning security signals into risk intelligence that tells leaders which risks are worth their attention. Each product has one named owner for what we build and why, and one named owner for delivery, so ownership is unambiguous by design.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

• GenAI Product Strategy & Roadmap: Define and execute the product vision for LLM-powered science and data agents, spanning prompt engineering strategies, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures, semantic parsing, and agent orchestration frameworks that enable autonomous reasoning at scale. Collaborate with scientists to evaluate trade-offs between fine-tuned domain models and in-context learning approaches for optimal accuracy-latency balance.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Tech, Amazon Manufacturing Services
jobs.description:
Amazon Manufacturing Services (AMS) is seeking a Sr. Product Manager, Tech to own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the manufacturing execution and automation intelligence stack powering Amazon’s first advanced manufacturing facility — a highly automated, first-of-its-kind operation. This facility integrates industrial robotics, end-to-end manufacturing automation, and digital manufacturing to produce systems for Amazon’s global fulfillment network.

Key job responsibilities
Manufacturing Execution Product Strategy
• Own the 2–3 year product roadmap for the manufacturing execution stack — from scheduling UX through operator tools to AI-powered optimization
• Define the product vision that connects AI-native scheduling intelligence to the physical shop floor experience
• Develop and maintain the execution technology strategy across P0 (manual + semi-automated), P1 (AGV integration, real-time optimization), and P2 (AI-enabled autonomous control)
• Write compelling narratives (PR/FAQs, 6-pagers, OP docs) that articulate product strategy and secure investment from leadership

Scheduling & Operator Experience
• Serve as the operational product partner to the scheduling engineering team — translating manufacturing floor needs, pain points, and workflows into product requirements
• Own the operator-facing scheduling experience: how assignments surface, how disruptions are communicated, how overrides are captured, and how the system explains its decisions to the right audience
• Drive the scheduling system’s authority progression (Shadow → Advisory → Co-Pilot → Decision Maker) by defining success criteria, measuring override rates, and building supervisor trust through UX design
• Define product requirements for scheduling and explainability tools from the operator/supervisor perspective

Machine Connectivity & IIoT
• Own the product vision for machine connectivity — defining how equipment telemetry flows from factory floor to data lake to decision systems
• Define integration requirements for manufacturing equipment onboarded at the manufacturing facility (industrial lasers, robotic welding cells, automated coating lines, autonomous mobile robots)
• Develop product requirements for digital twin capabilities — real-time equipment state, simulation for what-if analysis, and predictive modeling
• Partner with automation engineers to define the machine-to-cloud data contract for each equipment class

AI/ML & Continuous Improvement
• Define and execute product strategy for AI-driven manufacturing intelligence: predictive maintenance, automated quality inspection, process parameter optimization, and autonomous cell control
• Own requirements for the data platform layer that enables ML — feature stores, event streams, model serving infrastructure
• Drive the feedback loop between quality outcomes (first-pass yield, scrap rates) and upstream process adjustments — ensuring the system learns and improves continuously
• Define the operator interaction model for AI recommendations — when to alert, when to auto-act, when to require human confirmation

Shop Floor Quality & Compliance
• Own the product experience for in-line quality: inspection workflows, non-conformance reporting, root cause analysis tools, and SPC dashboards
• Define how quality data flows back to both the scheduling system (for replan triggers) and the enterprise system (for financial variance reporting)
• Partner with Quality Engineering to translate ISO 9001:2015 requirements into tool capabilities and audit-ready data records

A day in the life
In the morning, you review overnight production data from our prototyping factory — the scheduling system’s override rate dropped to 7% this week, and you’re preparing the case to promote it from Shadow to Advisory mode. You pull the override-reason breakdown to identify two UX issues driving unnecessary supervisor interventions, then draft requirements for the engineering team.

Mid-morning, you join the scaled factory equipment onboarding review. The laser cutting integration team needs a decision on telemetry frequency — you work through the tradeoffs between data granularity (better for predictive maintenance models) and network cost (lower in batch mode), landing on a tiered approach by signal type.

After lunch, you’re on the prototype factory floor shadowing a powder coating operator through a disruption scenario — a rush order just reshuffled the queue, and you observe how the shop floor app communicates the change. The operator missed the notification; you sketch a design change in your notebook.

You close the day reviewing the ECO blast-radius prototype with the engineering team. An engineering change landed that affects 47 in-flight orders — the impact visualization needs to surface at-risk-dollars more prominently for the Change Control Board’s decision meeting tomorrow.

- Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields
- 7+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- Experience defining roadmap strategy and prioritizing deliverables for your team products
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience with analytical tools and ability to dive deep into metrics and reporting
- Experience with manufacturing execution systems (MES), shop floor scheduling, or production control software
- Experience managing technical products or online services in manufacturing or industrial environments
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in high-volume manufacturing operations or sourcing environments
- Experience in practical work applying ML to solve complex problems
- Experience with concepts such as system architecture, optimization, system dynamics, system analysis, statistical analysis, reliability analysis, and decision making
- Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools
- Knowledge of cutting-edge production technologies and delivery workflows
- Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or other related discipline
- Experience presenting complex ideas in writing in the form of authoring white papers, proposals, or other formal strategy documents
- Knowledge of IIoT protocols (OPC UA, MTConnect, MQTT) and industrial data integration
- Experience in high-volume, high-mix manufacturing environments (metals fabrication, welding, coating, assembly)
- Experience with ISO 9001 or similar manufacturing quality management systems
- Knowledge of Industry 4.0 principles, smart manufacturing architectures, or software-defined manufacturing

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Tech, AME Search Marketing
jobs.description:
The primary responsibilities of the Search Marketing organization are to drive web site traffic, maximize channel revenue and improve the end customer experience wherever they are in their shopping journey across the web. We manage Earned (SEO) and Paid Search marketing channels on external search engines and emerging partners including AI driven experiences and run experiments with a view to programmatically improve our ROI and find levers to grow the Amazon stores business. Our channel is one of the largest levers for Amazon business and new customer acquisition. We work with internal customers across all levels of the organization worldwide and enjoy the challenges and rewards of working in a fast-growing organization.

We are seeking a seasoned Product Manager to lead Paid Search channel marketing for one of Amazon's largest managed traffic driving channels. In this role, you will lead the development and execution of the paid and organic digital marketing strategy. This is a high-visibility position with scope for creativity and self-development. You will develop a detailed understanding of digital marketing (SEO/SEM in particular) and understand the long-term financial impact of customer behavior trends. The role requires a highly analytical mindset as well as a curiosity to seek out new possibilities. You should be strong at and attracted to the analytical and technical side of digital marketing as well as to the creative and experimental side, consistently using one to inform the other. You will be comfortable thinking big and diving deep. You will be the single point of contact and a dedicated owner for specific areas of the business and will be the search team's expert for that product line, gathering insights and applying learnings to additional lines of business / countries.

The successful candidate will think strategically and execute rigorously. You must be able to thrive in an entrepreneurial environment and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities. You will anticipate and remove bottlenecks, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance the business needs versus constraints. You will be at the center of the customer experience and need to dive into the customers’ responses, incremental business impact, and budget justification on your program, which requires strong analytical skills. - Translate channel insights into test plans, product/feature proposals, and opportunities for optimization

- Conduct in-depth analyses to refine our understanding of the search space and uncover additional optimization opportunities
- Translate analytical findings into actionable insights and concise business actions and recommendations

Your morning starts with a partner sync shaping how AI-powered Ad formats replace traditional search targeting approaches for optimization. Before your coffee gets cold, you're reviewing an ML model classifying millions of queries into intent channels with scientists. You'll juggle external partners, science teams, marketing managers across countries, and engineering sprints — often in the same hour. jobs.description:
The Opportunity

What if you could teach machines to make millions of delivery decisions — faster, smarter, and more efficiently than ever before? We're looking for a Senior Product Manager - Tech who's obsessed with the intersection of artificial intelligence and real-world operations to join Amazon's Sub Same Day team. This isn't about incremental optimization. This is about building intelligent systems that autonomously orchestrate one of the most complex delivery networks on the planet — in real time, at massive scale.

You will define and drive the product roadmap for AI/ML-powered solutions across the Sub Same Day delivery network — from supply chain planning and real-time capacity allocation to delivery and anomaly detection. You'll identify high-impact business problems ripe for AI disruption, translate them into well-scoped technical product requirements, and build the business case to secure investment. Your multi-year product vision will leverage state-of-the-art techniques — large language models, reinforcement learning, computer vision, and graph neural networks — to fundamentally reimagine how last-mile delivery works at Amazon scale.

You will serve as the connective tissue between data scientists, system development engineers, business intelligence engineers — ensuring technical feasibility, architectural soundness, and delivery velocity. You'll own the end-to-end product lifecycle: from problem framing and data pipeline design through model development, A/B experimentation, production deployment, and continuous iteration. This means making hard trade-off decisions across model accuracy, latency, infrastructure cost, and customer experience — with a deep understanding of the technical constraints and opportunities. You'll drive technical debt reduction and platform scalability, ensuring AI systems are production-grade, fault-tolerant, and built for exponential growth.

You will partner with operations, logistics, finance, and science teams to ensure AI solutions are grounded in operational reality and deliver measurable business value. You'll influence senior leadership with data-driven narratives, translating complex ML concepts into clear strategic recommendations, and build scalable processes for feature prioritization, sprint planning, and release management across distributed engineering teams.

What Makes This Role Different

Your AI products will make decisions affecting millions of packages daily across Amazon's fastest-growing delivery channel. You'll work with large-scale ML platforms (SageMaker, custom training infrastructure), and production inference systems operating at sub-100ms latency. Sub Same Day is still early in its AI journey — you'll have the rare opportunity to define the foundational AI strategy from the ground up, not just optimize existing systems. From the data that feeds models to the customer experience those models create — you own the full stack of outcomes.

- Lead the product strategy and roadmap for AI/ML initiatives in the Sub Same Day delivery network
- Orchestrate collaboration between data scientists, engineers, operations teams, and business stakeholders
- Define and prioritize product requirements based on customer needs and business impact
- Develop business cases and ROI analysis for new AI initiatives
- Drive technical requirement gathering and documentation
- Lead sprint planning and backlog prioritization sessions
- Monitor key performance metrics and adjust strategies based on data-driven insights
- Identify and resolve cross-team dependencies and conflicts
- Champion product innovations to senior leadership and key stakeholders
- Drive go-to-market/adoption strategies for new AI-powered features and capabilities

jobs.description:
Amazon is seeking an experienced ERP Product Manager to own the product strategy and delivery of global consolidation and financial reporting capabilities as part of a large-scale Finance ERP transformation.

The successful candidate will bring strong accounting and consolidation expertise, experience managing enterprise financial products, and working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting or comparable consolidation platforms.
You will serve as the product owner for consolidation and Group Reporting, partnering closely with Accounting, Controllership, Finance, Solution Architecture, Engineering, SAP, and implementation partners. You will define business capabilities, establish product requirements, prioritize features, evaluate design alternatives, and guide the product through design, build, testing, deployment, adoption, and ongoing improvement.
This role requires an individual who can move between detailed accounting requirements and broader product decisions. You will need to understand how legal-entity structures, accounting policies, ownership relationships, currencies, intercompany activity, and reporting requirements translate into a cohesive enterprise consolidation product.

• Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle for Amazon’s global consolidation and Group Reporting capabilities.
• Define the future-state product capabilities required to support statutory and management consolidation, controllership, and financial reporting.

Amazon Devices & Services has committed to an ambitious path toward net-zero carbon. Getting there means measuring, reducing, and eliminating the carbon footprint of our products at a scale and speed that manual processes simply can't match. Our team builds the software, platforms, and intelligent systems that make that possible — turning slow, manual sustainability analysis into fast, AI-assisted work, so our scientists and program managers can focus on the highest-impact carbon-reduction work.
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager – Technical to own a portfolio of the products and platforms at the center of this mission. You'll work hand-in-hand with a team of software engineers who specialize in AI development, and you'll own products end to end — from customer problem to shipped, adopted, and measurable capability. - Ground decisions in the customer and the data— run customer discovery and voice-of-customer research, establish success metrics and baselines, and use adoption and impact data to decide what to build, scale, or stop.
