We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager Tech, Product Quality, Perfect Order Experience (POE)
jobs.description:
Amazon customers expect every product they receive to be authentic, undamaged, and exactly as described. The Global Product Verification (GPV) team builds AI-powered computer vision and machine learning systems that detect product quality defects — counterfeit, expired, damaged, and wrong-item products — before they reach customers, protecting trust at fulfillment center scale.

As a Senior Product Manager-Tech for GPV, you will own the product strategy and technical architecture for Amazon's Unified Image Pipeline — a multi-modal CV/ML system that fuses RGB imaging, X-ray analysis, OCR, and visual similarity with confidence-based routing to automatically detect and enforce product defects across the fulfillment network. You will drive end-to-end ownership of the product quality investigation journey, making architectural trade-off decisions across ML model design, hardware-software integration, and pipeline orchestration. You will partner with applied scientists, software engineers, hardware teams, and operations stakeholders to define the technical vision, prioritize capabilities, and ship solutions that reduce product condition complaints for hundreds of millions of customers worldwide. This role offers the opportunity to shape how Amazon verifies product authenticity and condition at global scale through AI/ML systems.

Key job responsibilities

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager, Relay Trust
jobs.description:
Have you ever thought about what it takes to detect and prevent fraudulent transactions so that hundreds of millions of Amazon packages are received on time by our customers? What kinds of products and systems would you build to maximize customer satisfaction? Amazon is seeking a Senior Product Manager who is passionate about protecting customers and can thrive as an individual contributor on a diverse, global team.
The Relay Trust organization in Transportation Technology and Services (TTS) constantly innovates new ways of building distributed systems running the latest in machine learning algorithms to deliver the next generation of fraud prevention solutions for our customers. We hold high standards for our solutions and the services we deliver: our systems are highly secure, highly reliable, highly available, all while functioning at massive scale and delivering industry-leading precision. Our employees are intelligent, passionate about protecting customers, and fun to work with.
As a Senior Product Manager, you will own a defined product area within our fraud prevention portfolio. You will analyze and identify specific instances of risk, broader risk trends, and points of customer friction, then define and deliver scalable products and solutions for prevention. You will collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams worldwide and within TTS to solve problems, create operational efficiencies, and deliver against high organizational standards. You will apply a breadth of tools, data sources, and analytical techniques to answer a wide range of high-impact business questions, and you will proactively present new insights in a concise and effective manner. You will work directly with partners in engineering and machine learning to develop new tools and revise risk models. You will also build the operational and business metrics for your area and use those metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
This is an individual contributor role. You will own the roadmap for your product area end to end, from problem definition through launch, and you will drive results by partnering closely with engineering, science, and business stakeholders.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the product vision and roadmap for a defined risk detection and prevention area, aligning priorities with engineering, science, and business stakeholders against shared goals.
• Lead well-scoped problems that carry significant ambiguity, breaking them down into clear requirements and a deliverable plan.
• Define product requirements and success metrics for automation, machine learning, and tooling investments that improve fraud prevention accuracy and operational efficiency.
• Drive data-informed product decisions by leveraging business analysis, risk trends, and customer friction insights to prioritize the highest-impact opportunities within your area.
• Build scalable measurement frameworks and continuous monitoring products focused on carrier partner compliance and emerging risk areas.
• Partner across engineering and science teams to translate new technologies (ML models, signals, identity verification) into shipped product capabilities.
• Mentor junior product managers and business analysts, and contribute to the norms and standards of the product team.

About the team
Relay Trust is the fraud prevention and risk management product team within Amazon's Transportation Technology and Services (TTS) organization. Our mission is to protect Amazon's middle-mile transportation network, our carrier partners, and ultimately our customers from fraud, misuse, and abuse at global scale. We build products powered by machine learning, real-time signals, and data-driven decision systems that detect and prevent risk across identity verification, cargo integrity, and carrier compliance.

TTS's vision is to reinvent how customers of all sizes move goods, powered by tech, driven by science, and guided by data. Within that mission, Relay Trust operates at the intersection of product innovation and operational protection. Our systems process thousands of decisions per second, integrate signals from GPS, cameras, and device telemetry, and directly influence billions of dollars in transportation
transactions annually.

We are a cross-functional team spanning product management, engineering, applied science, and risk operations across North America and Europe. We value bold invention over incremental improvements, move fast through simple solutions, and believe constraints fuel our best work. You will collaborate with senior leadership with high visibility, and partner across 10+ organizations to ship products that make logistics safer and more efficient at planetary scale.

- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience as a product manager or owner
- Experience owning technology products

- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager, Amazon Customer Service
jobs.description:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. Serving over 200M customers globally, our Customer Service (CS) organization is at the forefront of shaping how customers experience Amazon. Our team enables Amazon to be the leader in customer service capabilities creating valuable and memorable experiences for customers as they engage across our services, platforms, and devices.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager (L6) to help define the strategy and own continuous evolution of customer service models. This role sits at the intersection of data, design, and customer experience: you will use escalation patterns, customer effort signals, and resolution data to diagnose where service models are working, where they are degrading, and where they need reinvention. Rather than optimizing a single product surface, you will look across the full spectrum of service experiences to identify cross-cutting patterns and design systemic solutions that raise the floor for every customer. You will define the “what should change and why,” validate hypotheses through experimentation, and partner with engineering and operations teams to bring validated designs into production.

The ideal candidate is a strategic, systems-level thinker who leads with data. You see patterns others miss by connecting signals across multiple service experiences rather than treating each in isolation. You are equally comfortable building a measurement framework, writing a narrative that reframes a complex problem, and rallying cross-functional teams around a shared vision. You thrive in ambiguity, move from diagnosis to experimentation quickly, and have a track record of turning data into customer outcomes at scale.

Key job responsibilities
• Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for evolving existing customer service models, grounded in a data-driven understanding of where models are working, degrading, or failing
• Analyze escalation patterns, customer effort metrics, and resolution data to identify cross-cutting failure modes and improvement opportunities across multiple service experiences
• Design service model changes and define hypotheses; validate proposed changes through structured experimentation before they reach customers
• Define and own a measurement framework that connects service model quality to customer outcomes; use metrics to prioritize investments and quantify impact
• Partner with engineering, data science, UX design, and operations teams to move validated designs into production, ensuring changes translate cleanly from experiment to implementation
• Influence senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders through compelling, data-backed narratives that connect individual model improvements to the broader customer experience strategy

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Technical, Audible Fraud Defense
jobs.description:
At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

ABOUT THIS ROLE
Want to protect creators, customers, and the integrity of the world's leading audio storytelling platform? Come join the Audible Fraud Defense team as a Senior Product Manager - Technical, where you will own the product strategy and roadmap for Audible's fraud defense and anti-piracy capabilities across all global marketplaces.

Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling, with over 1MM titles, 141K+ creators, and listeners in 180+ countries. As we scale our content catalog and creator ecosystem, the sophistication of fraud and piracy threats grows with it — from creator royalty harvesting and payment fraud to large-scale content piracy on platforms like YouTube. We need a product leader who can define and drive the technical product strategy that stays ahead of these evolving threats.

ABOUT YOU
In this role, you will own the end-to-end product vision for Audible's Fraud Defense program — spanning creator fraud, customer fraud, and content piracy. You will define what to build, why it matters, and how to measure success. You will work closely with engineering, data science, legal, content, and security teams to translate complex fraud signals into durable product mechanisms that protect our ecosystem at scale. The ideal candidate brings deep experience building trust & safety or fraud prevention products, strong technical judgment for evaluating detection and enforcement architectures, and a track record of driving product strategy in ambiguous, high-stakes domains.

As a Senior Technical Product Manager for the Audible Fraud Defense team, you will…
- Own the product roadmap for Audible's fraud defense program across three risk domains: creator fraud (royalty harvesting, copyright infringement, listening manipulation), customer fraud (payment fraud, account abuse, policy exploitation), and content piracy (DRM circumvention, unauthorized distribution, platform scraping). Define how fraud risk is modeled, detected, and acted upon across Audible's global marketplaces
- Drive the product strategy for Audible's anti-piracy capabilities, including application attestation to detect inauthentic app access, YouTube Content ID integration for automated takedown, audio watermarking for forensic source tracing, and anti-scraping detection systems. Define graduated enforcement frameworks that balance customer experience with content protection
- Own the product vision for Audible's fraud detection and enforcement platform — defining how signals from consumption patterns, payment behavior, account activity, and content distribution are evaluated to identify and contain fraud. Partner with data science and engineering to improve detection precision, reduce false positives, and scale automated enforcement across all marketplaces
- Build product mechanisms that protect creator royalties from exploitation while ensuring legitimate creators and customers are not negatively impacted. Define how trust scoring, abuse thresholds, and appeal processes work across the creator and customer lifecycle
- Partner with Content, Legal, Engineering, Security, Customer Service, and external partners (publishers, industry associations, anti-piracy vendors) to align on fraud prevention strategy and drive execution. Represent the fraud defense program in executive reviews (Monthly Fraud Review, OP1/OP2). Influence without authority across organizations with competing priorities
- Define and own key fraud metrics — detection rates, false positive rates, financial impact avoided, takedown success rates, and operational efficiency. Use data to inform roadmap priorities, report program impact, and drive risk-based decisions with leadership

ABOUT AUDIBLE

jobs.description:

Each segment has different selection, pricing, fulfillment, and credit requirements, and neither is adequately served by existing Amazon B2C tooling. -Drive delivery of in-flight initiatives:
-Define and execute the 3YF product vision.
-Leverage AI and automation to shift AWIPL from reactive firefighting to predictive decision-making: WBR diagnostic platforms, causal knowledge graphs, predictive OOS models, and CPS deal workflow automation eliminating 100+ hours/month of manual coordination.
-Communicate strategy, progress, and blockers to senior leaders weekly and align partner team leadership to prioritize AWIPL's roadmap asks above competing demands.

About the team
AWIPL is Amazon India's B2B retail entity, operating at the intersection of 1P retail and enterprise B2B. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Technical , OMHS Software, Controls, and Science
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager, Technical to own an entire product within our industrial automation portfolio. You will define product strategy, vision, and roadmap independently. You will not manage features on someone else's product; you will own a product end-to-end, from customer problem identification through deployment and operational performance, with direct accountability for business outcomes.
In our operating model, PMTs own their products cradle to grave. You will engage directly with software development managers and science managers to co-own technical decisions, evaluate complexity, and make prioritization calls. You will define acceptance criteria, own the P&L framing for your product (cost-to-run vs. business value delivered), and drive cross-functional alignment without relying on intermediaries for day-to-day coordination.
This is a role for someone who can operate with limited guidance. The product strategy may not yet be fully defined. The customer segments may be emerging. The technology approach may need to be evaluated. You will drive clarity from ambiguity and establish the product direction that engineering teams build against.

Key job responsibilities
Product Strategy and Ownership
- Define and own the product strategy, vision, and multi-quarter roadmap for your product area
- Work backwards from customer needs to identify the right problems to solve and the right sequence to solve them
- Own the business value framing: cost-to-run, operational entitlement delivered, adoption trajectory, and reliability targets
- Make build/buy/partner decisions with clear business justification
- Own your product from problem discovery through deployment and sustained operational performance
Direct Engineering Partnership
- Engage engineering leaders directly to present requirements, evaluate complexity, and co-own technical direction
- Influence architecture decisions through data-driven contributions and customer evidence
- Evaluate whether to build new capabilities, extend existing systems, or leverage partner team investments
- Define acceptance criteria that engineering builds against, with clarity on what "done" means
Customer Voice and Research
- Conduct customer research through site visits, office hours, and direct operational observation in fulfillment buildings
- Treat internal operations and support teams as first-class customers, proactively collecting their needs
- Use data to identify performance trends, adoption patterns, and areas of customer friction
- Translate customer pain into prioritized engineering work with quantified business justification
Deployment and Post-Launch
- Manage Phase Gate Reviews with Operations during deployment to live sites
- Ensure training content ships as a product requirement, not an afterthought
- Own post-launch support plans including triage, issue management, and continuous improvement
- Define and monitor KPIs: adoption, reliability, cost savings, customer satisfaction

A day in the life
Your morning might start reviewing telemetry from your product's overnight performance across deployed sites, identifying an anomaly that needs investigation. Mid-morning, you're meeting directly with your engineering lead to discuss technical trade-offs on a feature that has three possible implementation paths with different timeline and scalability implications. After lunch, you're running Product Office Hours with field technicians to understand a workflow pain point they've been working around. Later, you're writing a product narrative that makes the case for a roadmap pivot based on data from your latest site visits. You end your day reviewing a deployment readiness checklist with operations stakeholders for a building launching next month. Your customers are the operators, technicians, and engineers who use your product daily in fulfillment buildings, and the leadership team making investment decisions about the portfolio.

About the team
We are a division within Amazon Fulfillment Technology and Robotics focused on standardizing the equipment and systems that make up our first, middle, and last mile facilities. We are a passionate group of innovators, engineers, and business leaders dedicated to reducing the variability and complacency in our current logistics systems. Our team thrives on collaboration, continuous learning, and the shared vision of developing technologies to bring innovation and scalability back to our automation equipment.
Amazon installs a significant quantity of new buildings every year. The historical model allowed each integrator to use their own equipment, controls, subsystems, and methodologies. While that enabled Amazon to succeed to this point, the variability between buildings has proven difficult to support and scale. Our charge is to build partnerships focused on consistency and scalability across the network of the future, partnering with key suppliers to help them scale manufacturing capabilities and refining their designs to drive innovation, operational uptime, and better meet the specific needs of Amazon's operational environment.
Our software organization delivers the platforms, controls architecture, and AI/CV capabilities that enable Amazon to own its industrial automation ecosystem end-to-end. The product ecosystem spans machine-level controls, unified SCADA visualization, computer vision, and AI-driven design tooling, all built on a shared telemetry foundation and deployed to fulfillment sites globally.

On any given day you might lead a design review with engineers on a new deliverability feature, align with Solutions Architecture on an enterprise customer's integration, or drive a strategic discussion with leadership on your service's three-year vision. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Driver Safety Technology, Global Road Safety
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about using technology to save lives and prevent injuries? Do you want to lead the invention and construction of safety solutions that will protect hundreds of thousands of third-party drivers across Amazon's vast middle mile and delivery networks? Amazon is building disruptive safety technology products with the vision of creating the safest middle mile and last mile delivery operations in the world. We are studying the safety needs of line haul and delivery drivers and building innovative, market-leading solutions that will fundamentally transform how we protect drivers on the road every day.

You will be both an entrepreneur and an operator who will plan and scale safety technology across the driver network. You will define the driver safety experience, partner with Tech, Engineering, Operations, Safety, Legal, and Compliance teams to design solutions that make for safer on road operations. You will thrive in ambiguity, building and communicating a clear approach and ensuring that we are delivering strong safety outcomes with each technology deployment that impacts on road operations. You will be expected to regularly display the following abilities: 1) High ownership and accountability for driver safety outcomes with the ability to plan and deliver on critical safety goals 2) Ability to navigate ambiguity with flexibility and decisiveness while balancing safety improvements with operational priorities 3) Skills to work across diverse stakeholders teams to communicate, convince and deliver for the goal and 4) Ability to think big on a vision for transformative driver safety technology while being rooted in constant execution and measurable safety improvements.

This is a highly visible and inherently critical role with room to innovate and solve key road safety challenges at scale. Strong experience designing and launching impactful products in a complex and cross-functional environment is necessary.

Key job responsibilities
· Develop a thorough understanding of safety challenges facing middle mile truck drivers and last mile delivery drivers, including vehicle safety, road safety, route optimization for driver protection, fatigue management, and incident prevention while monitoring new developments in driver safety technology and the regulatory landscape.

· Define and own the driver safety product roadmap and strategy – develop the vision for implementing next-generation safety solutions including vehicle telematics, driver assistance systems, in-vehicle safety technology, predictive safety analytics, and real-time risk mitigation tools for drivers across all regions and operations.

· Write and present compelling business cases (backed by strong research and driver safety data analysis) for safety technology investments in partnership with all stakeholder teams

· Partner with Tech, Operations, Engineering, Safety, Compliance, and Legal teams to design customer backward safety experiences that protect drivers in Amazon's delivery network.

· Own end-to-end product development from requirements to launch – write business requirement specifications, monitor project execution, and ensure delivery is to the appropriate levels of quality and safety standards.

· Monitor and report on driver safety metrics and KPIs to senior leadership across Amazon, as related to the safety products being developed and deployed – track driver incident rates, near-miss events, safety technology adoption, and demonstrate measurable improvements in driver safety across middle mile and last mile operations.

· Drive adoption of safety features across the third-party driver network – ensure that safety solutions are effectively planned, implemented and utilized by drivers across thousands of line haul routes and delivery routes

· Ensure compliance with Department of Transportation (DOT), Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA), Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA), and other regulatory requirements while staying ahead of evolving driver safety regulations

· Manage complex, multi-stakeholder programs with compressed timelines – be tenacious and find creative approaches to meet deadlines and delivery the product roadmap.

· Create clear, effective written communication to present decision points or data-based arguments that enable delivering on driver safety goals. Communicate to diverse audiences ranging from technical teams to senior leadership.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Technical, Quick Sight - Structured Data Analytics
jobs.description:
Amazon Quick is a decision intelligence service for the AI era. Today, thousands of enterprises and millions of users rely on Quick to connect their data, generate insights, and turn decisions into action — whether through interactive dashboards, embedded analytics woven into the products their customers use, natural language experiences that let any knowledge worker ask a question and get an answer they can act on immediately or fully managed tools that they can build and deploy for their stakeholders. Hundreds of ISVs and SaaS companies have already built Quick into the fabric of their applications, powering experiences for millions of end users who benefit from intelligent, data-driven products. That is the kind of reach we operate at — and we are just getting started.

We are now at an inflection point. The convergence of structured data analytics, natural language interfaces, and agentic AI is rewriting the rules of what a decision intelligence service can do — not just for analysts, but for every knowledge worker in an enterprise. Quick sits at the center of this shift. We're building the service that lets an enterprise analyst build a governed dashboard in minutes, an ISV embed AI-powered analytics into their product with a few API calls, and a business leader ask a question in plain English and receive an insight they can turn into action before the day is over. The same service. The same governed data. One experience that scales from a single user to an entire organization — unlocking productivity, surfacing new opportunities, and accelerating businesses that are powered by data.

We are hiring multiple Senior Product Managers in the Quick Sight, the structured data analytics product team to own critical parts of this journey. These roles span some of the most consequential product areas in cloud analytics and decision intelligence today:

- The data and intelligence foundation — how enterprises bring structured and unstructured data together under a unified semantic and governance layer that powers both BI reporting and AI-driven insights that turn into action.
- Embedding and ISV enablement — how thousands of software companies build differentiated, analytics-rich products on top of Quick's capabilities, and how we make that experience so seamless it becomes the default choice for every builder.
- Business model and growth strategy — how we design packaging, pricing, and adoption pathways that make it effortless for customers to start, experiment, and scale with us — turning first deployments into enterprise-wide commitments.

What unites these roles is a shared profile: a deeply technical product leader who is equal parts strategist and practitioner. Someone who can see the three-year arc of a market and then roll up their sleeves to ship the next release. Someone who works backward from the customer's deployment — not from a requirements document — and who measures their own success by whether the customer succeeded. Someone who sees a nascent, fast-growing business not as a risk but as a canvas.

Quick is a business that is growing, evolving, and actively being shaped by the people on this team. You will have a direct and visible thumbprint on a service that is becoming the decision intelligence layer for enterprises and AI-powered products alike. The decisions you make — about what we build, how we package it, who we build it for, and how we bring it to market — will define how thousands of organizations and millions of knowledge workers experience data, make decisions, and take action in the age of AI.

If you are a builder who gets energy from ambiguity, who thinks in systems but ships in increments, and who wants to be at the frontier of where decision intelligence meets artificial intelligence — we want to talk to you.

Key job responsibilities
- Drive product delivery in deep partnership with engineering, applied science, and design. Drive product specifications, make crisp tradeoff decisions, and ensure high bar on the quality and user experience

- Be hands-on with the technology. Whether that means understanding how a semantic model resolves a natural language query, how an embedded analytics SDK integrates into a partner's React app, or how a pricing SKU flows through AWS billing — you operate at the level of detail where real product decisions are made.

- Own the customer journey from first contact through enterprise-wide adoption for critical engagement. Partner with GTM and Sales teams to design onboarding pathways, migration playbooks, and growth motions that reduce friction, accelerate time-to-value, and turn successful deployments into organization-wide productivity gains.

- Engage directly with enterprise customers, ISV partners, and AWS field teams. Turn what you hear into product conviction — not just feature requests, but insight into where the market is moving and what customers will need before they know to ask for it.

- Directly contribute to business outcomes — adoption, revenue, competitive win rates, customer retention. Use data relentlessly to prioritize, to make the case for investment, and to communicate progress to senior leadership.

Artificial intelligence (AI) is changing both what customers build as well as what they must defend and how they defend it. Autonomous agents now take actions, access data, and call other systems on their own, creating a new security and identity challenge that every enterprise is racing to understand. At the same time, AI is becoming one of the most important tools defenders have. Together, these shifts represent the biggest change in cybersecurity in a generation.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is investing to lead through that shift. We have long set the standard for security of the cloud, and we are building on that foundation in two directions: helping customers secure their AI workloads, agentic applications, and the identities that AI introduces; and delivering a portfolio of AI-powered enterprise security services that use AI and autonomous agents to help defenders work at machine speed.

This role sits at the center of that work. As a Senior Product Marketing Manager (PMM) for AWS Security and Identity, you will help define how AWS talks about both a key domain in securing AI and/or using AI to secure, and own the category narrative for a space that is going through one of the most consequential shifts in security. You will work backwards from customer needs to influence product strategy in your domain and partner with product and go-to-market teams to identify the customers who care most, understand their use cases, develop messaging and drive marketing initiatives that help them adopt AWS security services with confidence.

If you thrive at the intersection of technology and business strategy, and you want to shape how the world secures the AI era, this role is for you. You will be part of a team that learns together, experiments and iterates, and is building a strong culture along the way.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As a Senior Reliability Product Manager - Tech, you will focus on developing internal tools and mechanisms to improve product reliability, quality, and supplier management processes and implementation of various automated tools and tracking mechanisms.

Key job responsibilities
1) Metric Automation:
· Collect product requirements for key reliability and quality metrics
· Develop Page 0 metrics for products supported by IRQ
· Collaborate with partner teams to create tooling and tracking mechanisms
· Develop tools to report metrics periodically and flag endemic issues
2) Supplier Qualification Management:
· Create a tool to manage supplier qualification requests for Long Lead Equipment (LLEs)
· Implement a tracking system for 360-degree evaluations
· Ensure proper quality and reliability evaluations are performed
· Establish data archiving processes and internal approval procedures
· Develop reporting and compliance mechanisms
3) Tier 2 Component Tracking:
· Collaborate with the EAM team to develop a tracking system for Tier 2 components
· Estimate the Tier 2 component lifespan to drive business decisions on maintenance, replacement, and end-of-life strategies

About the team
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of end to end product delivery experience
- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 5+ years of mission critical facilities experience
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, product marketing, or business development
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools
- 7+ years in product, program, and/or technical leadership for large scale strategic initiatives in the data center infrastructure domain
- Masters degree in Engineering, product marketing, or business development.
- Experience writing documents on business requirements for new products, product development proposals, process improvement initiatives and/or product roadmaps

jobs.title: Principal Product Mgr. - Tech, Programmatic Reporting, Measurement, Ad Tech, and Data Science (MADS)
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced, highly technical, customer-focused Principal Product Manager – Technical to lead the development of high scale programmatic reporting solutions. This role will play a pivotal part in helping advertisers measure, analyze, and optimize their campaigns across Amazon Ads, and supporting high volume partners with that same mission. AI is changing how advertising is planned, analyzed and optimized, and the foundation of this opportunity is data. By delivering advertising reporting and actionable insights, our team empowers global advertisers to connect their campaign investments with real customer outcomes. By delivering that data programmatically through a thousand metrics and dimensions at high scale, we deliver the fundamental data powering AI agents, machine learning models, analytics engines and dashboards across the world. If you’re passionate about building high-scale data products for technical users and developing solutions that impact millions of customers, this is the role for you!

As part of the Programmatic Reporting team, you will define the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of technical solutions designed to help advertisers and partners understand their advertising investments by delivering dozens of data sets through unified data interfaces. You will collaborate closely with engineering, solution architects, and go-to-market teams to build robust, programmatic data products. You will help advertisers understand the effectiveness of their campaigns while empowering tooling providers, and AI teams acquire the data they need to make rapid data-driven decisions. Your responsibilities will include working backward from the customer and their engineering teams to identify needs, analyzing data and dogfooding our own products while partnering with our teams to build high scale, consistent and low latency data delivery engines at industry leading scale.

Amazon is investing heavily in building a world class advertising business and we are at the forefront of that explosive growth. We deliver campaign reporting for all of Amazon Ads and produce analytics and reporting insights that are used by advertisers to grow their business every day. We are highly motivated and collaborative with an entrepreneurial spirit and agile bias for action. With a broad mandate to experiment and innovate, we are growing at an unprecedented rate with a seemingly endless range of new opportunities. We start with the customer and work backwards in everything we do, including advertising. If you’re interested in joining a rapidly growing team with a relentless focus on the customer, you’ve come to the right place.

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of delivering data products at scale, with strong analytical, technical and problem-solving skills. They will be just as at home on a command line, writing curl requests, or using an agent to prototype a tool as they are writing epics or refining a sprint with a team. They will have excellent written and verbal communication skills, enabling them to effectively influence stakeholders and drive cross-functional collaboration. This role will be open to Toronto or New York offices.

Key job responsibilities
Product Strategy and Vision: Define multi-year roadmap and investment priorities, working backwards from the needs of enterprise advertisers, third-party integrators, and internal tooling teams.

Technical Product Development: Partner with engineering and data teams to deliver high-scale, low-latency data delivery systems; author detailed product requirements, epics, and user stories.

Data Quality and Standards: Ensure freshness, accuracy, and consistency across all reporting surfaces; own the metrics and dimensions catalog and reporting data layer standards.

Customer and Developer Experience: Drive adoption through intuitive interfaces, high-quality documentation, and streamlined onboarding that minimizes time to first report.

Go-to-Market Execution: Lead product launches and deprecations; align GTM, partner, and solution architect teams on enablement and adoption strategies.

Emerging Capabilities: Incubate next-generation interface programs, including GenAI-powered reporting and data lake integrations.

About the team
The Measurement and Data Science (MADS) organization sits at the heart of Amazon Ads, responsible for data infrastructure, measurement, research and reporting that enables advertisers to understand and optimize their advertising investments.

Within MADS, the Programmatic Reporting team builds the data interfaces that power how advertisers and partners measure their Amazon Ads outcomes. We own Amazon Marketing Stream and the Reporting APIs, delivering accurate, consistent, and timely data at massive scale to advertisers and partners worldwide. Our work sits at the intersection of data engineering and developer experience while opening doors to GenAI-powered interfaces and data lake integrations. We move fast, think in systems, and obsess over data quality.
Basic qualifications:
- 8+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 4+ years of end to end product delivery experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements
- Experience owning data-centric products
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Knowledge of SQL
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
- Experience leading engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Tech, Live Events Advertising
jobs.description:
Amazon's Advertising Technology team builds the technology infrastructure to manage billions of advertising queries every day. The result is better quality advertising for publishers and more relevant ads for customers. In this organization you'll experience the benefits of working in a dynamic, entrepreneurial environment, while leveraging the resources of Amazon.com (AMZN), one of the world's leading companies.

Amazon Publisher Services (APS) helps publishers of all sizes and on all channels better monetize their content through effective advertising. APS unites publishers with advertisers across devices and media channels. We work with Amazon teams across the globe to solve complex problems for our customers. The end results are Amazon products that let publishers focus on what they do best - publishing.

APS is revolutionizing live sports advertising with high-performance ad technology and real-time optimization across the world's biggest sporting events. We're building the next generation of infrastructure for live sports—tackling millisecond-critical decisioning at Amazon scale while delivering effective monetization for publishers and relevant ads for viewers.

As a Principal Product Manager - Tech, you will be the strategic product leader responsible for establishing a multi-year product vision for our live sports solution. You will define how we transform the supply landscape for live sports advertising: identifying and onboarding premium publishers and broadcasters, designing innovative supply products that differentiate our solution, and building technical capabilities that unlock superior advertiser performance. You will own the product strategy and roadmap, develop compelling experiences that attract and retain high-quality live sports publishers, and drive global supply growth.

This role requires deep technical understanding of infrastructure, server-side ad insertion, programmatic auction mechanics, and real-time bidding at scale. You will work closely with engineering, demand-side teams, and publisher development to drive adoption and optimize outcomes across the advertising stack.

A successful candidate brings strategic product vision with a relentless focus on supply-side innovation. You thrive in ambiguity while delivering concrete results, lead through influence at all levels, and bring technical depth to transform complex supply challenges into breakthrough product solutions. You can identify unmet publisher needs, develop sophisticated growth strategies, and drive roadmaps that balance near-term publisher wins with long-term transformation of the live sports advertising experience.

Key job responsibilities
• Define and own the product vision and multi-year roadmap for our live sports product, developing business cases for new product capabilities
• Identify and prioritize product opportunities that unlock revenue growth across supply and demand partners
• Design and execute multi-year product strategies that enable compelling go-to-market approaches, including product packaging, pricing models, and sales enablement
• Lead product requirements definition and work closely with engineering teams to deliver innovative solutions
• Drive product-led partnerships that enhance our network offering and publisher value proposition
• Influence cross-functional teams including engineering, sales, business development, and operations to align on product strategy
• Own product performance metrics, business reviews, and strategic planning processes with senior leadership
• Represent product strategy and decisions to executive stakeholders

About the team
Amazon Publisher Services (APS) helps publishers of all sizes and on all channels better monetize their content through effective advertising. APS unites publishers with advertisers across devices and media channels. We work with Amazon teams across the globe to solve complex problems for our customers. Our work spans product development, technology innovation, and cross-functional collaboration as we shape the future of advertising at Amazon.

- 10+ years of end to end product delivery experience
- 10+ years of technical product or program management experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience leading engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience technical product management

jobs.description:
AWS Interactive Video Service (Amazon IVS) is AWS's fully managed live streaming service, built on the same battle-tested technology that powers Twitch and trusted by thousands of enterprises across gaming, social, live commerce, sports, and entertainment.

Our mission: enable developers to build communities around live video. We handle everything from ingest to processing to delivery at global scale, so developers can focus on creating interactive, engaging live experiences for their audiences. Whether you're streaming to tens of millions of concurrent viewers or just getting started, Amazon IVS removes the complexity so developers can move fast.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will play a critical role in identifying and executing on opportunities to innovate and deliver new value to our developer customers. This is a high-ownership, multi-faceted role spanning product and business strategy, customer discovery, engineering, and go-to-market execution. You should have a proven track record of working directly with developers, understanding their needs, and building products that solve real business problems. The ideal candidate will bring both expertise in video streaming technologies and strong technical aptitude across APIs and SDKs, enabling you to partner effectively with engineers and customers.

AWS Interactive Video Service (Amazon IVS) is a managed live streaming solution from AWS that enables low-latency and real-time video experiences for millions of viewers worldwide. jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager, Progression Intelligence
jobs.description:
As a Senior Product Manager on the Lifecycle Experiences team, you will own the product vision and execution roadmap for our Progression Intelligence charter. This charter sits at the intersection of machine learning, real-time decisioning, and customer lifecycle strategy - and is responsible for determining which customers to engage, with what action, at what moment, and through which channel.

You will lead the technical integration of our rewards optimization, causal measurement, and action intelligence systems onto a unified agentic orchestration platform - enabling faster experimentation, more personalized interventions, and greater operational efficiency across all our emerging locales.

This is a deeply technical role that requires equal comfort with ML systems, API architecture, and product strategy. You will work closely with applied scientists, software engineers, and marketing stakeholders to ship systems that directly delight millions of customers.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the multi-year product roadmap for Progression Intelligence, including the phased migration of core ML models and decisioning systems onto a unified orchestration platform
- Define technical requirements and integration specifications for connecting rewards optimization, propensity modeling, causal incrementality measurement, and promotion configuration systems into a cohesive, real-time decisioning layer
- Partner with applied scientists to translate model outputs into actionable product features - including reward denomination optimization, next-best-action recommendations, and personalized campaign triggers
- Drive quarterly planning and prioritization across a portfolio of integrations, balancing technical debt, engineering capacity, and business impact
- Define and own success metrics for the Progression Intelligence platform - including model coverage, decisioning latency, incremental lift, and customer settlement outcomes
- Write product requirement documents and participate in technical design reviews, and lead alignment across engineering, science, and business stakeholders
- Represent the Progression Intelligence charter in senior leadership reviews, including weekly business reviews and annual planning cycles
- Identify and resolve technical dependencies and cross-team blockers to keep the integration roadmap on track

About the team
The Lifecycle Experiences team is on a mission to deepen customer engagement across Amazon's fastest-growing marketplaces. We own the end-to-end customer lifecycle - from first purchase to habitual shopping - across India, Mexico, Brazil, Turkey, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Australia, Singapore, and South Africa. Our north star is moving customers from occasional buyers to loyal, high-frequency shoppers.

We build and scale programs including Gamified Experiences, Rewards, Promotions Orchestration, and Personalization - reaching millions of customers across our fast growing marketplaces. We operate at the intersection of product, marketing, and data science, and we move fast.
Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience as a product manager or owner
- Experience owning technology products
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
- Master's degree or equivalent

jobs.description:
Amazon Elastic Block Store (EBS) is looking for an seasoned product manager and disruptive thinker to help us define the vision and strategy for block storage on AWS. As a member of the team you'll work alongside engineers and leaders to develop and operate one of the largest distributed systems in the world.

In this position, you will define product requirements, business and go-to-market strategy, and pricing for a set of critical new EBS features, while tirelessly champion the needs of our customers. This role will require coordination across many internal and external teams and will be visible at the highest levels of the company. You’ll work with our customers, partners, and operational stakeholders to prioritize roadmap features, and lead the definition of new capabilities through expertly crafted PR/FAQs.

A successful candidate must have exceptional problem solving skills, strong business judgment, and demonstrated experience leading cross-functional teams. We are looking for a proven ability to execute both strategically and tactically, and someone with creative vision who is excited to take on new, ambiguous, and disruptive projects that will be industry-defining. This position requires a solid technical background and strong analytical skills. You must be genuinely passionate about solving problems for customers and excited about cloud technologies, and be able to communicate your ideas clearly verbally and in writing. Past experience in with large-scale SaaS applications is helpful, but not required.

Key job responsibilities
* Defining products by working backwards from the needs of different customer segments / jobs-to-be-done
* Managing the entire product life cycle from strategic planning to tactical execution
* Establishing goals and analyzing metrics and product usage data to identify opportunities and deliver success
* Leading user research projects to identify new opportunities to innovate on behalf of our customers
* Working closely with engineering to make prioritization and tradeoff decisions
* Defining the vision, product strategy and roadmap for our products and working with key stakeholders in the company to deliver on that vision, e.g. sales, partner teams, international site leaders, etc.

* Responsible for the go-to-market plan and enablement, working to ensure that sales, SAs, and our partner teams have what they need to be successful

Your day might start with a couple of calls with a startup, then large international Enterprise customer who you have selected to interview about pain points in a feature area you're researching. You have a loosely-held hypothesis, but you want to deeply understand the customers' use cases and unique challenges. You then meet with the Director of Engineering to discuss product roadmap and resource allocation. Mid-morning, you collaborate with product marketing and business development on go-to-market strategies. After lunch, you have blocked off a couple hours to analyze product usage data to confirm/disconfirm one of your hypotheses and work on the PR/FAQ for the feature. Your day ends with preparation for a strategy meeting with our VP on how we grow the business, then you trot off to happy hour with some of your PM colleagues.

We value work-life balance. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
On EBS, we truly care about developing the careers of our product managers. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded PM.

• Develop and execute product strategy for new ad formats and viewer experience innovations in Prime Video, driving the roadmap from concept through launch and iteration.

• Lead or critically influence planning and execution of all aspects of product implementation, including product definition, engineering delivery, and go-to-market.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Voice of the Customer, Speed
jobs.description:
Do you want to be a part of a key investment area for Amazon that is focused on rapid expansion and delivering for customers at some of the fastest speeds across Amazon? Interested in insights and trends that inform how we improve and grow our Speed business? Excited about a fast-paced environment where you get to define experimentation plans, partner on roadmap development and ensure we’re delivering against our customers expectations for a multi-billion dollar product offering?

The Speed team is looking for a Principal Product Manager who will stand up a new Voice of the Customer function to support the Speed business. The Principal PM is constantly innovating on behalf of customers, and you will serve as the go-to expert on "what customers think and why" for Speed product and leadership teams. You will partner with reserach teams to design and execute qualitative and quantitative research (surveys, interviews, etc) with methodological rigor appropriate for executive-level decision-making. You will work closely with partner teams in selection, CX, customer funnel, UX Research to execute the roadmap and vision you develop. You will coordinate business stakeholders across the company to scale and optimize our sub same day service for customers. You will monitor and react to customer needs and feedback, constantly improving and expanding our service. Your work will directly impact the shopping experience of millions of customers globally by improving their ability to discover, understand and select the delivery options that best fit their needs.

Candidates should have prior experience with customer feedback loops, strong analytical abilities, high business judgment, and a keen customer focus. This role requires skills at breaking down complex, high-level ideas into executable features and distinct phases, a core focus on selection performance for key metrics, as well as prioritization and trade-off evaluation. The ability to influence cross-functionally and across the organization, at all levels, will be absolutely critical to success in this role.

Key job responsibilities
• Collect and identify customer and business insights and trends that inform how we improve and grow our Speed business. Serve as the go-to expert on "what customers think and why" for Speed product and leadership teams; provide research-backed input to planning cycles (OP1/OP2), business reviews, and product strategy.
• Design and maintain scalable mechanisms to continuously capture customer sentiment, pain points, and unmet needs related to delivery speed experiences. Expand these mechanisms across speed services and globally.
• Define and execute a research agenda aligned to Speed product priorities, balancing proactive discovery research with reactive deep-dives on emerging issues.
• Deliver research-backed recommendations that directly inform product roadmap prioritization, feature design, and investment trade-offs for Speed offerings.
• Identify and characterize distinct customer segments by speed sensitivity, ordering behavior, and satisfaction drivers to inform product targeting and investment decisions.
• Monitor external trends, competitive signals, and internal CS metrics to surface emerging customer needs and opportunities before they become escalations.
• Design and execute qualitative and quantitative research (surveys, interviews, conjoint analyses, concept tests, usability studies) with methodological rigor appropriate for executive-level decision-making.
• Raise the bar on customer research rigor across Speed product teams; establish documentation standards and self-serve insight resources so PMs can access prior findings independently.
• Partner with BI/analytics to define and validate customer experience metrics specific to Speed; determine what actions should be taken as a result of VoC findings.
• Partner with product managers and data science to design experiments that validate customer hypotheses before full investment. Track whether research findings translate into product or operational changes; maintain a backlog of insight-driven recommendations with owners and expected completion dates.

A day in the life
You’ll start your day reviewing forecast performance and investigating changes in customer demand. Throughout the day, you’ll collaborate with a senior planner and partner teams to refine demand inputs, troubleshoot anomalies, and deliver reporting that informs operational decisions. You’ll contribute to regular performance reviews, dive deep into forecasting models, and support planning for new delivery sites and initiatives. The pace is fast, the problems are ambiguous, and your work will directly support one of Amazon’s most ambitious delivery programs.

About the team
Our team looks at how we attract, acquire, engage, and retain customers across all the offerings in our same day portfolio. The team owns customer acquisition and retention strategy for all Speed programs -- you can expect all the challenges and benefits of a high-profile business: wide-open space for improvement and innovation, a strong team, and a fast-paced environment. These will require a willingness to dive into the details, solve new problems as they arise, leverage high judgment and gut instinct, and always obsess over customers. Everyone on the team wears multiple hats, and ownership of the customer experience is key.

You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We’re seeking an experienced Infrastructure Technical Program Manager in Herndon VA to oversee data center build projects in the Northern Virginia region. You will lead cross-functional and technical teams from conceptual design feasibility through requirements, budget, completed design, implementation, testing, and deployment. Along the way, you will use your judgment, negotiation skills, ability to influence without authority, analytical talent, technical aptitude, and leadership to collaborate with a diverse set of stakeholders across multiple time zones, manage capital budgets, eliminate non-value-add activity, design solutions, remove blockers, and find creative ways to accelerate project delivery.

The candidate must be comfortable managing remote project delivery teams, and possess the ability to facilitate technical whiteboard sessions to troubleshoot project implementation issues, and remove barriers to project success. Being able to stand up cross-functional teams, establish trust with a variety of stakeholders across multiple time zones, manage capital budgets, eliminate non-value-add activity, design solutions, remove blockers, and find creative ways to accelerate project delivery is a must.

The ideal candidate will be an exceptionally strong communicator, both written and verbally, and possess experience in tactical project management of highly technical initiatives, as well as strategic program management. They will be able to apply a variety of project management tools, methodologies and techniques for all phases of the project lifecycle and exhibit demonstrated experience in core project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality and risk management, reporting and metric development/tracking. Experience with MS Project, Asana, Tableau, and systems integration a plus.

The candidate will work through ambiguity, competing priorities, and be capable of understanding mechanical/electrical engineering concepts. Experience in managing data center infrastructure deployments is a plus. Candidates possessing a background in architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/hardware engineering, data center infrastructure/operations, and/or construction, who have transitioned to a program management discipline will have a distinct advantage.

If you enjoy the challenges of deploying highly technical and innovative projects at massive scale, this job is for you!

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Annapurna Labs
jobs.description:
Annapurna Labs designs the custom silicon that powers AWS's machine learning infrastructure, including the Trainium and Inferentia chip families. Our next-generation ML accelerator is a multi-die chiplet using state-of-the-art packaging technology, and it is the most complex hardware program Amazon has undertaken. We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to own end-to-end program execution for this chip, from RTL freeze through tape-out and into production readiness.

This is not a status-reporting role. You will be the person who connects a sprawling set of engineering workstreams into a single coherent schedule, identifies the real critical path week to week, and drives the cross-functional decisions that keep the program on track. The program spans multiple concurrent silicon development efforts with significant interdependencies across engineering disciplines, external partners, and infrastructure.

Key job responsibilities
Own the integrated schedule and critical path analysis across multiple die tape-outs through engineering samples and production ramp. Understand dependency chains deeply enough to calculate the impact of any slip or pull-in, and update the timeline weekly with real data.
Drive the weekly chip status cadence by synthesizing inputs from RTL/DV, physical design, packaging, power, infrastructure, and post-silicon teams into a single view that tells leadership where we actually stand, including what is getting worse and what needs action.
Track verification convergence as a leading indicator by monitoring the progression from feature completion through RTL closure, bug trends, and regression pass rates by block. Recognize when convergence is stalling and drive the engineering response before downstream milestones are affected.
Manage the external design partner interface, owning the netlist delivery calendar, tracking your partner's physical design timeline, and negotiating schedule trades with a clear understanding of downstream cost.
Drive infrastructure readiness and external IP delivery by partnering with compute and EDA platform teams on capacity planning, and tracking third-party PHY, memory interface, and controller IP deliveries against consuming blocks to escalate gaps before they become tape-out critical.

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing verification convergence dashboards and regression results, spotting a block where bug closure rates haven't flattened. You pull the DV lead and RTL owner into a quick sync to agree on a recovery plan before the weekly chip status review. In that review, you walk leadership through an updated critical path that reflects a netlist delivery shift from your external design partner, quantifying the downstream impact on tape-out timing. After lunch, you join an infrastructure capacity review to confirm that compute clusters can handle the regression load through freeze, then close out the day preparing an executive summary for an upcoming program milestone review.

About the team
The Annapurna Labs ML Accelerator team builds the Trainium and Inferentia silicon that trains and serves machine learning models across AWS. We work at the intersection of chip architecture, physical design, verification, and infrastructure to deliver products that push the boundaries of performance and efficiency for our customers. Our team values people who bring strong technical judgment, clear communication, and a willingness to get into the details. If you want to shape how Amazon builds its most ambitious hardware and work alongside talented engineers solving real problems at scale, this is the role for you.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
- 10+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
- 10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- Deep working knowledge of the chip development lifecycle: RTL verification milestones, physical design convergence, DFT, and timing closure.
- Experience managing programs with external design partners and IP vendors where you don't control the resources but own the outcome.
- Demonstrated ability to build and maintain integrated schedules with real dependency modeling — not just Gantt charts, but an understanding of which paths have float and which don't.
- Strong technical communication skills: ability to present crisp status to VP-level audiences, distinguishing signal from noise, and framing decisions clearly.
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience with multi-die / chiplet / advanced packaging programs (2.5D/3D integration).
- Familiarity with HBM integration, die-to-die interfaces, or high-speed serial subsystems.
- Experience with leading-edge foundry nodes and their specific flow and schedule characteristics.
- Background in ML accelerator or high-performance compute silicon.
- Experience driving infrastructure capacity planning for large-scale chip development programs.

jobs.description:

AWS operates the world's largest fleet of storage servers powering Compute and AI/ML workloads at cloud scale. Our team designs, builds, and operates this fleet — solving systemic hardware issues and building systems that detect and prevent recurrence, so customers experience the highest quality of service.

We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive end-to-end delivery of Storage servers across our global fleet. You will coordinate cross-functional engineering teams spanning hardware, firmware, and software, manage ODM partnerships across multiple continents, and establish closed-loop quality systems that drive continuous improvements. This role requires technical depth to translate engineering constraints into program risk, combined with program management excellence to deliver complex hardware at global scale.

What You Will Do
You will own programs where the critical path runs through silicon, firmware, and software teams simultaneously. You will translate ambiguity into structure: turning a fleet telemetry signal into a corrective action plan with quantified failure rates, a customer requirement into a new platform milestone with EVT/DVT/PVT gates, or a manufacturing escape into a design change with updated validation criteria. You will drive decisions on program trade-offs — adjusting scope when qualification gates slip, balancing deployment speed against fleet risk, and determining when to accept interim mitigations instead of holding for root-cause fixes. When a large scale of Storage servers depends on your program landing on time, you are the one ensuring hardware readiness, qualification completeness, and operational handoff happen without gaps.

Why You Will Love It
The world's most advanced frontier models are trained on the platforms you help build. Your programs launch the Storage servers that power the largest Compute and AI/ML workloads on the planet. You will see your decisions reflected in fleet reliability metrics within weeks of deployment. The team is small and high-trust — you own programs end to end from concept through production, with direct access to leadership and engineering alike.

The Ideal Candidate
You have deep technical intuition across hardware and software — enough to challenge engineering decisions, not just track them. You thrive in ambiguity, bringing structure to programs where requirements, timelines, and dependencies are still forming. You align priorities across teams in different organizations, and you escalate with data, not noise. You actively mentor and develop others — TPMs and engineers alike. You contribute to hiring, promotion assessments, and raising the bar for program management practices in your organization.

• You manage large, complex technology initiatives, delivering critical solutions, significant improvements, new mechanisms, or deprecating systems that are no longer needed.
• You successfully manage all stages (from concept to delivery).
• You understand the architecture of the systems you work with (e.g., workflows, APIs, runtime characteristics, design limitations, and maintenance requirements). You influence team technical priorities and business strategy through data-driven contributions.
• You communicate ideas effectively, verbally and in writing, to a wide range of audiences including Directors and VPs. You foster a constructive dialogue, harmonize discordant views, and lead the resolution of contentious issues (build consensus). You partner successfully with customers, stakeholders, and engineering teams.
• Your program management practices set a great example to others. You routinely and efficiently deliver the right things. You define clear goals and objectives. You drive crisp decisions in your program area about what projects move forward and in what priority order. You proactively identify risks and bring them to the attention of your team and stakeholders with plans for mitigation before they become roadblocks.
• You are a simplifier. You judiciously add, refine, and remove procedures. By applying project management best practices, you increase the productivity and effectiveness of the teams you work with.

A day in the life
You start the day syncing with ODM partners across time zones on build status and open engineering actions. Mid-morning, you run an engineering review connecting firmware, software, and hardware teams to unblock a qualification gate. In the afternoon, you triage a fleet reliability issue with operations data, drive alignment on corrective actions, and update executive stakeholders on program risk posture. You end the day reviewing NPI milestone readiness and ensuring the next design review has clear entry criteria.

Located in Seattle, Denver, and Cupertino, we collaborate with global development teams and ODM partners to deliver next-generation Compute and AI/ML infrastructure deployed in datacenters worldwide.
